group_elderly_female.ref_zh_text: 「上週我叫他在湯裡放一點大蒜。他放了大蒜，然後就忘了這回事。所以他又去放了一些。然後他又忘了自己放過。所以他又放了更多。嗯，你可以想像 Lord British 最後嚐到那碗湯時臉上的表情！幸好我們是在如此公正的統治者的城堡裡生活和工作。」
group_elderly_female.ref_en_text: "Well, look around! There are rich men who live in opulent castles. And right outside are poor people who live in hovels. Thou dost know how there are winged gargoyles and wingless gargoyles? Well, it seems the human race is getting to be just as divided. There is no unity in the land anymore. It is why I have joined The Fellowship."

group_elderly_male.ref_zh_text: 「嗯，Lord British 自己也感染了某種疾病。他派人找我。我一離開病人就趕到城堡檢查了國王。在我看來，似乎有什麼東西侵入了他的血液。我對此有一個理論，我堅信它是正確的。然而，其他人並不認同我的觀點。」
group_elderly_male.ref_en_text: "Well, Lord British himself was struck down with some sort of malady. He sent for me. I arrived at the castle as soon as I could leave my patients, and I examined the king. It appeared to me that something had infested his blood. I have a theory about it, which I am convinced is correct. Others, however, do not share my view."

group_middle_female_firm.ref_zh_text: 「這不僅適用於黃金，也適用於所有礦物。我們負責監督 Britannia 礦業公司 (Britannian Mining Company) 開採的珍貴礦石的銷售和兌換率。但我們不處理寶石的銷售。城裡有一家珠寶商負責處理那部分。」
group_middle_female_firm.ref_en_text: "Camille is a farm widow. She tends to live in the past, following the old virtues and questioning the ways of The Fellowship. These country folk are so superstitious, thou knowest. It is a fault of their low intellect. She does not even notice what a hooligan her boy, Tobias, is growing up to be! Not at all like our son, Garritt."

group_middle_female_troubled.voice_desc_zh: 女性，中年，沉穩有權威感，柔和，用標準的普通話朗讀
group_middle_female_troubled.ref_zh_text: 「好消息，大人！我丈夫被 Lord British 赦免了。他甚至為 Weston 提供了短期的工作，這樣他就能口袋裡帶著足夠養活我們一段時間的錢回到我身邊！
group_middle_female_troubled.ref_en_text: "I cannot join The Fellowship without feeling that I am betraying mine husband. How could I become one of those who have falsely accused him? Yet, if I do not, they will not allow my child and me to live here."

group_middle_female_warm.ref_zh_text: 你看見一位看起來很結實的農婦。她給了你一個好客的微笑，然後回到她的雜務上。
group_middle_female_warm.ref_en_text: "We sell those mostly to older people. Thou dost know, I am sure, how children do not like to eat their vegetables. Some people do not want to keep a lot of fruit in their home as they are afraid of attracting fruit flies."

group_middle_male_friendly.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-50歲，溫暖友善，語氣有活力，用標準的普通話朗讀
group_middle_male_friendly.ref_zh_text: 「我懷疑兇手——或者兇手們——是從外地來的，而且現在可能早就離開了。在今天之前，這裡已經有一段時間沒有發生過謀殺案了。我們相當程度的繁榮使得這裡的人們大多能互相包容。這就是吉普賽人定居在這裡的原因。顯然缺乏動機這一點令人費解。」
group_middle_male_friendly.ref_en_text: "I have known Owen as long as anyone in this town. Several years ago, three ships that he built sank. The brother of Karl, one of our more colorful local residents, was killed. No investigation was ever made into the cause of the sinkings, but Owen once confided to me that he secretly blamed himself. He started drinking heavily, and eventually took up with The Fellowship."

group_middle_male_rough.ref_zh_text: 他朝地上吐了口口水。「友誼會根本就是不列顛尼亞的毒瘤。他們有一種奇怪的理念，教導你忘記自己是誰並跟隨他們。這個過程使人失去人性，而且我認為這與八大美德背道而馳。不僅如此，他們在 Moonglow 的領導人還說服了 Tolemac 加入。」
group_middle_male_rough.ref_en_text: "milord? Thou, too, hast joined the evil organization? But how is this possible? Canst thou not see their tenets vie with the very virtues themselves? Dost thou not feel more like a sheep than a man? I am truly sorry, for if one of Britannia's greatest heroes has fallen in with such filth, then there is no hope for our great land!" He turns away in disgust.

group_middle_male_serious.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-50歲，沉穩有權威感，用標準的普通話朗讀
group_middle_male_serious.ref_zh_text: 「雖然我願意追隨這片土地的理想直到天涯海角，但我很難接受 Britannia 的情況如此糟糕。強盜橫行，疾病肆虐城鎮，議會充滿了腐敗。要不是有友誼會，我恐怕很難避免拔劍自刎，儘管這種行為看起來有多麼不光彩。」
group_middle_male_serious.ref_en_text: "Though I'd follow the land's ideals to the ends of the land, I find it difficult to accept how poor the conditions are in Britannia. Brigands populate the land, disease overruns the towns, and corruption fills the councils. Were it not for The Fellowship, I would be hard pressed to avoid falling on mine own blade, despite how dishonorable an act that may seem."

group_middle_male_worried.ref_zh_text: 「我擔心石像鬼可能會變得不安並攻擊我們。 Blorn 並沒有幫上忙。」他指著自己的胸口。「我負責維持這裡的秩序。如果沒有秩序，那就是我的責任。我已經問過 Eldroth 如果發生暴動該怎麼辦，我正在嘗試制定相應的計劃。」
group_middle_male_worried.ref_en_text: "I found the bodies first thing this morning when I went to open the sawmill. It took all of the discipline I have gained from the Triad of Inner Strength and the teachings of The Fellowship to keep from going mad at the sight of it. It must have happened sometime last night but I swear to thee I never heard a thing!"

npc_alagner.ref_zh_text: 「只有那些離開今生的靈魂才知道這些事。去尋找被折磨者（The Tortured One）的靈魂。問他關於生與死問題的答案是什麼。當你帶著正確答案回來時，我就會相信你是真心實意地在追求知識。只有在那時，我才會允許你借用筆記本。」
npc_alagner.ref_en_text: "Only those souls who have passed on from this life know these things. Seek out the spirit of The Tortured One. Ask him what the answers are to the questions of life and death. When thou dost return with the correct answer, I will believe that thou art sincere in thy quest for knowledge. Only then will I allow thee to borrow the notebook."

npc_amber.voice_desc_zh: 女性，20-30歲，溫暖友善，活潑有戲劇感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_amber.ref_zh_text: 「你能想像這種胡言亂語嗎？我不相信曾經有過一隻叫 Sherry 的老鼠。誰聽說過會說話的老鼠！尤其是這些台詞！我寧願演個女王。我得說，那對我來說合適多了。」
npc_amber.ref_en_text: "Canst thou imagine such drivel? I do not believe there ever was a Sherry the Mouse. Who ever heard of a mouse that could talk! Especially these lines! I would rather play a queen. Much more fitting for me, I would say."

npc_andrew.ref_zh_text: 「我第一次看到那間舊屠宰場時還是個小伙子。以前的老闆還帶我看過裡面的儲藏室一次。那扇門是鎖著的。我想 Morfin 把鑰匙放在他家裡的某個地方。」
npc_andrew.ref_en_text: "I was just a lad when I first saw the old slaughterhouse. The old man who owned it even showed me the storeroom in there once. The door to it is locked. I think Morfin has the key somewhere in his house."

npc_anton.ref_zh_text: 「他是一位居住在 New Magincia 的賢者。或許是全不列顛尼亞最博學的人！而現在，」他嘆了口氣，「我將不再有機會從他浩瀚的智慧寶庫中汲取知識了。」
npc_anton.ref_en_text: "He is a sage who resides in New Magincia. Perhaps the most learned man in all Britannia! And now," he sighs, "I will no longer have the opportunity to glean knowledge from his voluminous body of wisdom."

npc_balayna.voice_desc_zh: 女性，20-40歲，沉穩有權威感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_balayna.ref_zh_text: 「我忙於職責，在這裡認識的人很少。酒保 Phearcy 是社區的傑出成員，農夫 Tolemac 也是。Tolemac 的朋友 Morz 雖然害羞，但口碑很好。還有，Morz 有個兄弟。」她抬起頭若有所思。「或者他是 Tolemac 的兄弟？
npc_balayna.ref_en_text: "What's this?" she asks, taking the vial from you. She opens it up and sniffs. "Very good quality. I wonder why he..." she clutches her throat and gasps. You notice a wispy smoke rise from the top of the vial now spilling out of her hands. Choking, she falls to the ground, and dies.

npc_batlin.ref_zh_text: Batlin 以冰冷的無奈看著 Hook 死亡。當他轉向你時，時間似乎變慢了。"這場戰鬥還沒結束，聖者。你以為自己是不死的嗎？守護者遠比你想像的更強大。回到你那珍貴的地球去休息吧。
npc_batlin.ref_en_text: Batlin looks at you and his gaze returns to the Armageddon winter storm. "Many years ago, Avatar, I went to Skara Brae, the ghost city. The way the world is now reminds me of that dead place. In Skara Brae I had a spiritual experience so profound that I have never spoken of to another soul. I would like to share that experience with thee now, Avatar.

npc_battles.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，低沉有質感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_battles.ref_zh_text: 你面前的男人用狡詐的眼神打量著你。他微微彎著腰，彷彿隨時準備對周圍的世界發動攻擊。
npc_battles.ref_en_text: "The casino in Buccaneer's Den is called the House of Games and it the most fabulous place I have ever seen in me life. I shall never forget the first time Robin took me there. He walked away with a hundred gold pieces for less than an hour's work!"

npc_betra.voice_desc_en: Warm, mid-thirties male voice with a friendly yet commanding tone, suitable for welcoming and authoritative dialogue; retain character context: Male, gargoyle, welcoming wing-flap, friendly formal voice; visible traits: gargoyle with sweeping hand gesture
npc_betra.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，溫暖友善，沉穩有權威感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_betra.ref_zh_text: 「加入友誼會？」他搖搖頭。「這不是適合我的組織。我現在這樣很快樂，奉獻於祭壇。相信 Quaeven 是被友誼會的其他人誤導了。不信任他們，尤其是 Sarpling 。」
npc_betra.ref_en_text: "To join The Fellowship?" He shakes his head. "To be an organization not for me. To be quite happy as I am, devoted to the altars. To believe Quaeven to have been misled by the others in The Fellowship. To not trust them, especially Sarpling."

npc_beverlea.ref_zh_text: 你看到一位老婦人，她對你露出祖母般甜美的微笑。你可以立刻看出她的視力很差。
npc_beverlea.ref_en_text: "Let me see... There is a cradle for sale. A rocking horse. A bell. An hourglass. A spittoon. A lute. A sextant... Since I am moving a bit more slowly these days, I let my customers help themselves and take what they have bought. Providing they pay me first, of course. I do trust folks to pay me the correct amount. I am nearly blind, I am afraid."

npc_blacktooth.voice_desc_en: Deep and gravelly, conveying authority and suspicion; pace is steady but deliberate; retain character context: Male, 40s, suspicious pirate, rough threatening voice, chewing tobacco; visible traits: tall, middle-aged pirate with a suspicious expression
npc_blacktooth.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，低沉有質感，語速沉穩，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_blacktooth.ref_zh_text: 聖者我不信任他們。我認為他們都在隱瞞什麼。我認為他們都是騙子。拿我的老朋友 Mole 來說吧。嗯，我的前老朋友 Mole 。自從他加入他們之後，他改變了很多。」
npc_blacktooth.ref_en_text: "He has abandoned all of his pirate ways! He is a bloody saint now, and whenever he sees me he tries to convince me to join The Fellowship. I avoid him at all costs now. I cannot stand to see him this way. It burns my blood!"

npc_bollux.voice_desc_en: Male, elderly, A deep, resonant voice with a gentle cadence and a touch of wisdom, conveying both authority and calmness; retain character context: Male, gargoyle, deep gravelly voice, earnest and emotional, speaks with a heavy resonant tone; visible traits: Deep-set eyes, weathered skin, stone-like appearance

npc_bollux.ref_zh_text: 「可憐的 Bollux 並不知道 Castambre 之石。他的犧牲也許是不必要的。你碰巧見過 MacCuth 寫的《Castambre 之石》嗎？」
npc_bollux.ref_en_text: "Surely thou hast heard of the Shrines of the Three Principles: Truth, Love, and Courage! We golems were fabricated to protect the Shrines, for only an Avatar -- -the- Avatar -- may utilize the awesome power they can convey."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: Deep-set eyes, weathered skin, stone-like appearance

npc_boris.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，低沉有質感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_boris.ref_zh_text: 你告訴 Boris 你從海盜 Battles 那裡聽到的事。他冒出一身冷汗。「你看穿了我的謊言。我這就把它交給你。」他打開吧檯後面的一個秘密暗格，往裡面看去。當他轉頭看你時，臉色蒼白。「吊飾盒不見了！我向你發誓，我不知道它在哪裡！」
npc_boris.ref_en_text: You tell Boris what you had heard from the pirate, Battles. He breaks out into a cold sweat. "Thou hast seen through my deception. I shall hand it over to thee." He opens a secret panel from behind the bar and looks inside. When he looks back to you his face has lost all color. "The locket is gone! I swear to thee, I know not where it is!"

npc_brion.voice_desc_en: A mature male with a friendly and authoritative tone, speaking at a moderate pace; retain character context: Male, 30s-40s, scholarly man, calm intellectual voice; visible traits: friendly expression, scholarly appearance
npc_brion.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-50歲，溫暖友善，沉穩有權威感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_brion.ref_zh_text: 他自豪地笑了。「我想你會想要的。但是，有一個問題。我還需要一顆水晶才能完全完成檢視器。如果你去酒館，你可能會在那裡找到一位有時會提供給我水晶的商人或旅行者。如果你能找到另一顆水晶，我就能把完成的檢視器交給你。」
npc_brion.ref_en_text: He smiles proudly. "I thought thou wouldst. However, there is one problem. I still need one more crystal to completely finish the viewer. If thou wouldst visit the tavern, thou mightest find one of the merchants or travellers there who sometimes provide me with crystals. If thou canst find another crystal, I will be able to give thee the completed viewer."

npc_budo.voice_desc_en: Warm, jovial, and slightlynasal voice, conveying friendliness and authority; retain character context: Male, 40s, fat happy merchant, jolly booming voice; visible traits: Fat, cheerful-looking merchant with a jolly demeanor
npc_budo.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，溫暖友善，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_budo.ref_zh_text: 「我的曾祖父將店傳給他的兒子，就這樣一路傳到我。我們天生就是商人！這就是為什麼我知道你為什麼來 Budo 商行！你想成為偉大的 Budo 傳奇的一部分！你需要買點東西！」
npc_budo.ref_en_text: "There was a period shortly after my father died, just as I had inherited the shoppe, when business was poor. There was a danger that I would not be able to keep the shoppe open. But The Fellowship convinced me that I should join them. I proved my worthiness and The Fellowship helped me financially."

npc_elad.voice_desc_en: Warm and authoritative, with a gentle smile and a steady pace that conveys confidence; retain character context: Male, 20s-30s, smiling young man, cheerful polite voice; visible traits: smiling eyes, bowing posture
npc_elad.voice_desc_zh: 男性，20-40歲，溫暖友善，沉穩有權威感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_elad.ref_zh_text: 「Cubolt 擁有那個農場。他和他的弟弟 Tolemac 以及他們的朋友 Morz 一起管理它。我不是很確定，但我相信 Tolemac 最近加入了友誼會。」
npc_elad.ref_en_text: "Moonglow is mine home. I have lived in this town for mine entire life. But I am weary of my life here. 'Tis time, I think, to move on. If only I did not have such strong ties here."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: smiling eyes, bowing posture
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, 20s-30s, smiling young man, cheerful polite voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，20-30歲，微笑，開朗禮貌的，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_elynor.voice_desc_en: Elegant, mid-tempo, slightly condescending, warm yet authoritative; retain character context: Female, 40s, elegant and slightly傲慢 noblewoman, refined voice with a hint of condescension; visible traits: elegant and slightly arrogant noblewoman with a refined voice
npc_elynor.voice_desc_zh: 女性，中年，溫暖友善，沉穩有權威感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_elynor.ref_zh_text: 「 Frederico 和 Tania 把我們友誼會的所有成員當作有病一樣對待。特別是 Frederico 經常欺負我們的成員。你也知道，我們是和平主義者，這是常識。他甚至在他自己的人民中都有殘酷的名聲。他落得暴斃的下場並不令人驚訝。」
npc_elynor.ref_en_text: "We should strive to put this business of the murders behind us. Minoc will soon be known throughout Britannia as a city where majestic ships are built. There is even going to be a statue erected in the center of town honoring our shipwright, Owen. He is a skilled and valued member of our community and, of course, a Fellowship member."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: elegant and slightly arrogant noblewoman with a refined voice.
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Female, 40s, elegant and slightly傲慢 noblewoman, refined voice with a hint of condescension
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 女，40多歲，精緻中帶著一絲居高臨下的感覺，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_erethian.voice_desc_en: A deep, resonant voice with a slow, deliberate pace, conveying wisdom and authority; retain character context: Male, elderly, wise mage, calm and philosophical voice with a mystical quality, speaks slowly; visible traits: wise mage with a calm demeanor
npc_erethian.voice_desc_zh: 男性，年長，低沉有質感，語速沉穩，帶有智慧與閱歷，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_erethian.ref_zh_text: 年邁法師佈滿皺紋的眉頭上出現了小汗珠。「這比我預期的還要難一點。」他停下來用袖子尖擦了擦額頭，「我得引導一條地下小河，讓水井打水。那麼，現在你需要一些工具，才能使用這些設備，不是嗎？」他自問自答，同時再次準備向這個世界釋放他的意志。
npc_erethian.ref_en_text: Erethian nods his head when you tell him of your dilemma with the black sword. "Yes, I can see how the blade would be too clumsy to swing in combat. However, if thou were to bind a magical source of power into the hilt of the blade, thou mightest be able to counteract the unwieldy nature of the sword."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: wise mage with a calm demeanor
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, elderly, wise mage, calm and philosophical voice with a mystical quality, speaks slowly
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，年長，平靜而哲理的聲音帶著神秘的品質，緩慢地說著，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_fenn.voice_desc_en: Warm, slightly gravelly voice, mid-tempo delivery, conveying both authority and a hint of weariness; retain character context: Male, 30s-40s, beggar, pitiful pleading voice; visible traits: weathered, slightly disheveled appearance with a hint of melancholy or humor in the eyes
npc_fenn.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，溫暖友善，低沉有質感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_fenn.ref_zh_text: 「在你告訴他找到毒液瓶的事後，他說：『當你發現 Garritt 那個沒用的臭小子是小偷時，你為我們鎮上立了一大功！也許現在有些人會開始意識到友誼會的虛偽了！』」
npc_fenn.ref_en_text: You see a beggar. You cannot tell from the look on his face whether he is about to laugh or cry.

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: weathered, slightly disheveled appearance with a hint of melancholy or humor in the eyes.
_portrait_voice_analysis.temperament: mildly eccentric and somewhat unpredictable, with a touch of wisdom under the surface.
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, 30s-40s, beggar, pitiful pleading voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，可憐兮兮的哀求聲，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_feridwyn.voice_desc_en: Deep and resonant, with a calm authority and measured pace, conveying wisdom and experience; retain character context: Male, 40s, excited gossip, fast and eager voice, breathless with news; visible traits: weathered, wise, authoritative
npc_feridwyn.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，沉穩有權威感，低沉有質感，語速沉穩，帶有智慧與閱歷，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_feridwyn.ref_zh_text: 聖者！你知道商人 Morfin 被偷了一批銀蛇毒液嗎？這起竊案給社區帶來了不小的困擾。
npc_feridwyn.ref_en_text: "I have often said that Tobias was no good. Now here is proof. He is the thief that has been praying upon one of our honest merchants! And to think I let him come into contact with my son! I hope he shall be dealt with in a manner appropriate to one who is leading youth astray from the way of The Fellowship.

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: weathered, wise, authoritative
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, excited gossip, fast and eager voice, breathless with news
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，興奮的八卦，快速而急切的新聞時氣喘吁籲，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_ferryman.voice_desc_en: Deep, hollow voice, spectral tone, slow pace, authoritative, slightly eerie; retain character context: Male, elderly, spectral ferryman, deep hollow voice, ominous and slow; visible traits: hooded figure in a ghostly boat with skeletal features
npc_ferryman.voice_desc_zh: 男性，年長，沉穩有權威感，低沉有質感，語速沉穩，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_ferryman.ref_zh_text: 站在你面前的是一個高大、骨瘦如柴的身影，身處一艘幽靈船中。他向你伸出手，用陰森的聲音說：「我是 Skara Brae 的擺渡人……你必須支付兩枚硬幣……才能渡過迷霧海峽。」
npc_ferryman.ref_en_text: Before you stands a tall, skeletal figure in a ghostly boat. He holds out his hand to you, and says in a sepulchral voice, "I am the Ferryman of Skara Brae... Thou must pay two coins... to cross the Misty Channel."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: hooded figure in a ghostly boat with skeletal features
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, elderly, spectral ferryman, deep hollow voice, ominous and slow
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，老人，低沉空洞，不祥而緩慢，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_figg.voice_desc_en: Deep, authoritative voice with a hint of urgency and concern; retain character context: Male, 30s-40s, anxious fellowship member, worried hurried voice; visible traits: serious, focused
npc_figg.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，沉穩有權威感，低沉有質感，帶有憂慮感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_figg.ref_zh_text: 「我是友誼會的成員，沒錯。但我若把皇家果園的蘋果給友誼會將是一種犯罪，也是對我神聖職責的侵犯。雖然賣蘋果也是違規的，我只是想幫這個名叫 Weston 的人一個忙。而我想這些指控就是我得到的回報？哼！」
npc_figg.ref_en_text: "I am a member of the Fellowship, yes. But it would be a crime for me to give apples from the Royal Orchard to The Fellowship, and it would be a violation of my sacred duty. While selling apples is also a violation, I was only trying to do this man Weston a favor. And I suppose these accusations are the thanks I get? Hmph!"

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: serious, focused
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, 30s-40s, anxious fellowship member, worried hurried voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，焦急的，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_finnigan.voice_desc_en: Deep, gravelly voice with a hint of weariness, conveying authority and experience; retain character context: Male, 40s, determined investigator, serious and focused voice, slightly weary; visible traits: weathered, rugged appearance with a thick beard and stern expression
npc_finnigan.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，沉穩有權威感，低沉有質感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_finnigan.ref_zh_text: 「那是在我來到 Trinsic 之前的事了。曾經發生過一起有著驚人相似之處的謀殺案。發現了一具被肢解的屍體，就像可憐的 Christopher 一樣。那看起來像是一場儀式性的殺戮。我敢打賭，當年那起謀殺案的凶手就是這次事件的幕後黑手。」
npc_finnigan.ref_en_text: "A crime like this has never happened in Trinsic before. I cannot believe this happened to Christopher and Inamo. Please -- explore the town! I would appreciate it if thou wouldst bring me a report on thy progress. Be sure to ask everyone in town about the murder. After speaking with Christopher's son, thou mightest next want to speak with Gilberto, the guard on watch at the dock last night."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: weathered, rugged appearance with a thick beard and stern expression.
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, determined investigator, serious and focused voice, slightly weary
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，態度堅定，嚴肅專注，略顯疲憊，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_fodus.voice_desc_en: Mid-thirties male, rough and pained voice, slow and deliberate pace, conveying a sense of weariness yet determination; retain character context: Male, gargoyle, sick diseased gargoyle, rough pained voice; visible traits: sick gargoyle with patches of skin disease on face
npc_fodus.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，語速沉穩，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_fodus.ref_zh_text: 你看到一隻沒有翅膀的石像鬼，患有可怕的皮膚病。看起來他的臉似乎正一塊塊地掉下來。
npc_fodus.ref_en_text: A wave of delirium passes over the gargoyle. "To... to be going back to work now, Mikos!... To be working hard!... To have no need to give me any more of the the silver fluid..."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: sick gargoyle with patches of skin disease on face
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, gargoyle, sick diseased gargoyle, rough pained voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，粗糙痛苦的，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_for_lem.voice_desc_en: Deep, resonant male voice with a commanding tone, conveying ancient wisdom and authority; retain character context: Male, gargoyle, large wingless gargoyle, deep formal voice; visible traits: Large, strong wingless gargoyle with deep formal voice
npc_for_lem.voice_desc_zh: 男性，年長，沉穩有權威感，低沉有質感，帶有智慧與閱歷，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_for_lem.ref_zh_text: 「與 Lap-Lem 是朋友，並知道他是個好礦工。也認識 Ansikart ，在這個動盪的時代提醒我們奇點 (Singularity) 的存在。」
npc_for_lem.ref_en_text: "To be afraid for the future of gargoyle youths. To tell you they know little about their heritage. To feel it important to educate them and the offspring who follow them in our ways and history."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: Large, strong wingless gargoyle with deep formal voice.
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, gargoyle, large wingless gargoyle, deep formal voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，低沉的正式，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_foranamo.voice_desc_en: Male, middle-aged, Deep, gravelly voice with a commanding tone, conveying anger and resistance while maintaining a steady pace; retain character context: Male, gargoyle, angry resistant voice; visible traits: angry, gargoyle-like appearance with sharp features and a menacing expression
npc_foranamo.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，沉穩有權威感，低沉有質感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_foranamo.ref_zh_text: 這隻石像鬼的憤怒如此強烈，以至於他抵抗了法術。另一隻石像鬼也站了起來，憤怒閃過他的臉龐，他用手指著你，要求知道你是誰。
npc_foranamo.ref_en_text: The gargoyle's anger is so great that he resists the spell. The other gargoyle also stands. Anger flashes across his face as he points a finger at you and demands to know who you are.

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: angry, gargoyle-like appearance with sharp features and a menacing expression
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, gargoyle, angry resistant voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，憤怒反抗的，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_forbrak.voice_desc_en: Male, middle-aged, A deep, gravelly male voice with a warm and authoritative tone, conveying wisdom and experience; retain character context: Male, gargoyle, friendly research assistant, polite interested voice; visible traits: deep voice, slightly gravelly tone, authoritative yet gentle
npc_forbrak.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，溫暖友善，沉穩有權威感，低沉有質感，帶有智慧與閱歷，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_forbrak.ref_zh_text: 「是個獲取知識和鍛鍊的絕佳地點。由名叫 Quaeven 的石像鬼管理。這個 Quaeven 非常有學問。而且，像 Silamo 一樣，也是無翼的。」
npc_forbrak.ref_en_text: "To believe there are disagreements between the old philosophy and the new. To expect no violence, but to ask you to seek the trainer and healer. To know they are observant and may have seen something. To also suggest you speak with members of The Fellowship."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: deep voice, slightly gravelly tone, authoritative yet gentle
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, gargoyle, friendly research assistant, polite interested voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，友善的研究助理，禮貌感興趣的，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_forsythe.voice_desc_en: Deep, resonant voice with a hint of weariness and authority, conveying wisdom and resolve; retain character context: Male, 30s-40s, terrified ghost, fearful and trembling voice, desperate; visible traits: weathered, wise, authoritative
npc_forsythe.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-50歲，沉穩有權威感，低沉有質感，帶有智慧與閱歷，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_forsythe.ref_zh_text: 你看到一個幽靈般的男人蜷縮在角落裡。他以防禦的姿勢舉著生命護符，瘋狂地環顧房間，但沒有注意到你。
npc_forsythe.ref_en_text: "Oh, goodness no. I do not think I'm the one thou wantest for that job. No, I should think not. Maybe thou shouldst ask all of the townsfolk first. If none of them will do it, I might just think about it. Yes, that's right, thou shouldst just ask the others, then come back here to tell me who the poor soul is." He smiles at his own cleverness.

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: weathered, wise, authoritative
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, 30s-40s, terrified ghost, fearful and trembling voice, desperate
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，恐懼顫抖，絕望，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_frank.voice_desc_en: A mature male with a fox-like voice, authoritative and slightly playful, delivering dialogue with a steady pace and warm tone; retain character context: Male, fox, sly clever voice, standing on hind legs; visible traits: fox-like, sly expression, standing on hind legs
npc_frank.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，溫暖友善，活潑有戲劇感，沉穩有權威感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_frank.ref_zh_text: 「而且，」他停頓了一下，非常靠近地盯著你的臉，「我從沒注意到你的鼻子有多大。你還能找到足夠的空氣呼吸真是個奇蹟。」
npc_frank.ref_en_text: "That is the reason for thine offensive mouth odor. I have not seen anything that yellow since the time thy fellow Shamino ran away from a battle in fear."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: fox-like, sly expression, standing on hind legs
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, fox, sly clever voice, standing on hind legs
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，狡猾的，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_gargan.voice_desc_en: Deep and gravelly, with a hint of wheezing, conveying wisdom and experience in a friendly yet authoritative manner; retain character context: Male, elderly, salty old sailor, rough raspy voice, wheezing cough, gruff; visible traits: salt-and-pepper beard, weathered face, tobacco-stained clothing
npc_gargan.voice_desc_zh: 男性，年長，溫暖友善，沉穩有權威感，低沉有質感，帶有智慧與閱歷，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_gargan.ref_zh_text: 「是的，那艘船昨晚停泊在這裡。」他查看了他的日誌。「她在日出時開往 Britain 。我不記得有看到任何人上船或下船。」～ Gargan 哼了一聲，又咳嗽了幾下。
npc_gargan.ref_en_text: "Matey, I have always seen pirates and sailors with peglegs and hooks. If thou hast seen one, thou hast seen another." But the man suddenly frowns. "Hmm. Now that thou dost mention it, I -did- see a man with a hook late last night after sundown. I was leaving the shop and saw him outside. There was a wingless gargoyle with him. They were walking east."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: salt-and-pepper beard, weathered face, tobacco-stained clothing
_portrait_voice_analysis.temperament: gruff but friendly, seasoned sailor with a salty tongue
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, elderly, salty old sailor, rough raspy voice, wheezing cough, gruff
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，老人，粗啞，喘息咳嗽，粗聲粗氣，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_garok.voice_desc_en: Deep and authoritative, with a hint of urgency in the voice, conveying both intensity and suspicion; retain character context: Male, 30s-40s, intense mage, suspicious and intense voice, slightly manic; visible traits: wild eyes, intense mage
npc_garok.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，沉穩有權威感，低沉有質感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_garok.ref_zh_text: 「我腦海裡有一個聲音。某種惡魔之類的。它總是祝賀我做了某些事。然後其他時候又因為某些事罵我。我『知道』那不是我的良心。我『知道』『他』聽起來像什麼！這是……另一個人。」
npc_garok.ref_en_text: "Grrrr! They are a thorn in my side! They have been seeking me for the past three years! I neglected to report a certain amount of income for reagent distribution, and somehow they found me out. By the way, if thou shouldst ever care to visit me in the mountains, I can sell thee reagents at reduced prices!"

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: wild eyes, intense mage
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, 30s-40s, intense mage, suspicious and intense voice, slightly manic
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，可疑而激烈，略顯躁狂，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_garritt.voice_desc_en: A youthful, energetic male voice with a warm, inviting tone, conveying enthusiasm and friendliness; retain character context: Male, teen-20s, cheerful young man, bright and friendly voice; visible traits: jovial young man with friendly demeanor
npc_garritt.voice_desc_zh: 男性，年輕，溫暖友善，語氣有活力，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_garritt.ref_zh_text: 「我已經說過一千次了。Tobias 性格軟弱！他和他的母親很窮是因為他們很懶惰。現在證明我是對的，因為 Tobias 是個小偷。一個被抓住的小偷！」
npc_garritt.ref_en_text: "I thought that if Tobias were accused of stealing something that everyone would notice, his mother would join The Fellowship and force him to join, too. It would improve their lives and force them to see the truth about themselves."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: jovial young man with friendly demeanor
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, teen-20s, cheerful young man, bright and friendly voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，20多歲，個性開朗，明亮友善，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_geoffrey.voice_desc_en: A mature male with a warm and confident tone, speaking at a steady pace to convey authority and friendliness; retain character context: Male, 40s, captain of the guard, warm familiar voice, laughing; visible traits: warm, familiar, authoritative
npc_geoffrey.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，溫暖友善，沉穩有權威感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_geoffrey.ref_zh_text: 「這顯然是我們兩個世界的另一個不同之處。每當你回來時，就好像你的肉體是第一次來到這裡一樣。這也是為什麼你許多同伴選擇留在這裡，儘管他們在 Britannia 的時間流逝中已經變老了。」
npc_geoffrey.ref_en_text: "It is apparently another difference in our two worlds. Whenever thou shalt return it is as if thy physical body has arrived here for the first time. It is the reason why many of thine own companions have chosen to stay here even though they have aged in Britannian time."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: warm, familiar, authoritative
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, captain of the guard, warm familiar voice, laughing
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，溫暖熟悉的笑聲，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_gharl.voice_desc_en: Deep, raspy, middle-aged troll voice, slow and deliberate pace, conveying anger and hunger; retain character context: Male, troll, starving angry voice, deep growling; visible traits: troll with protruding ribs, growling voice
npc_gharl.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，低沉有質感，語速沉穩，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_gharl.ref_zh_text: 你看到一個巨魔 (troll) 在他的牢房裡生悶氣。當他呼吸時，你可以看到他的肋骨從皮下凸出來。
npc_gharl.ref_en_text: You see a troll, sulking in his cell. As he breathes, you can see his ribs protrude out from under his hide.

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: troll with protruding ribs, growling voice

npc_glenno.voice_desc_en: Deep and authoritative, with a hint of playful mischief in the tone. Pace is steady but engaging; retain character context: Male, 20s-30s, handsome fit man, charming slightly flirtatious voice; visible traits: handsome, muscular with an air of mischief
npc_glenno.voice_desc_zh: 男性，20-40歲，活潑有戲劇感，沉穩有權威感，低沉有質感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_glenno.ref_zh_text: 「是的，我是會員。如果不是因為友誼會，我就不會成為澡堂的經理！我為組織盡心盡力，信賴我的眾多弟兄，致力於合一，而且……嗯，我的價值先行於報償！而這一切……就是我的報償！」 Glenno 笑了，就像一隻剛吞下老鼠的公貓。
npc_glenno.ref_en_text: "Yes, I am a member. If it were not for The Fellowship, I would not be manager of The Baths! I served the group well, trusted my many brothers, strived for unity, and... well, my worthiness preceded my reward! And all of this... was my reward!" Glenno smiles as if he were a tomcat who had just swallowed a mouse.

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: handsome, muscular with an air of mischief
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, 20s-30s, handsome fit man, charming slightly flirtatious voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，20-30歲，身材帥氣，迷人，略帶妖艷，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_gordy.voice_desc_en: Deep and authoritative with a touch of oily sophistication, steady pace, warm yet commanding tone; retain character context: Male, 40s, wealthy pirate, oily pretentious voice; visible traits: elegantly dressed, rich, reeks of pomade
npc_gordy.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，溫暖友善，沉穩有權威感，低沉有質感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_gordy.ref_zh_text: 「賭坊 (House of Games) 是六年前用……一位利益相關者的資金建立的。它吸引了來自全 Britannia 想要用他們的錢過危險生活的人。這門生意非常有利可圖。」他拍了拍他的袋子，發出金幣叮噹的聲音。「非常有利可圖。」他笑著說。
npc_gordy.ref_en_text: "The House of Games was established six years ago with the funds of... an interested party. It attracts people from all over Britannia who wish to live dangerously with their money. The business is very profitable." He pats his pouch, and coins clink. "Very profitable." He grins.

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: elegantly dressed, rich, reeks of pomade
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, wealthy pirate, oily pretentious voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，油膩做作的，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_gorn.voice_desc_en: Deep, resonant voice with a hint of authority and warmth, conveying experience and wisdom; retain character context: Male, 40s, serious dwarf warrior, deep gruff voice, loyal and wary; visible traits: bearded warrior with stern expression
npc_gorn.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，溫暖友善，沉穩有權威感，低沉有質感，帶有智慧與閱歷，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_gorn.ref_zh_text: 你看到一張熟悉的臉，是個嚴肅的大鬍子戰士，你曾在上一次前往 Britannia 的旅途中見過他。
npc_gorn.ref_en_text: Gorn seems distracted for a moment. He puts his hand to his ear as if he is listening to something. He looks back at you with a shocked expression on his face. "I haf just heard de voice ov Brom and he says dat I should not trust thee! I tought dat thou vert my friend, Avatar! Go avay! I do not vish to speak vith thee again!"

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: bearded warrior with stern expression
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, serious dwarf warrior, deep gruff voice, loyal and wary
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，低沉沙啞，忠誠而警惕，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_grod.voice_desc_en: A middle-aged male troll with a deep, gruff voice that conveys authority and slight displeasure. Pace is steady and deliberate; retain character context: Male, troll, deep dumb gruff voice, growling and angry, simple speech; visible traits: Troll-like appearance with a deep voice
npc_grod.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，低沉有質感，語速沉穩，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_grod.ref_zh_text: 「除了那個。他不尖叫。他只會說話。說個不停。我無聊到快瘋了。所以我折磨得更多。結果，」他攤開雙手，「他說得更多了！我不知道該怎麼辦。」
npc_grod.ref_en_text: "Except that one. He not scream. He just talk. And talk. I get so bored I get mad. So I torture more. And," he throws up his hands, "he just talk more! I no know what to do."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: Troll-like appearance with a deep voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.temperament: Gruff but not angry; slightly disapproving tone
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, troll, deep dumb gruff voice, growling and angry, simple speech
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，深沉啞啞的咆哮和憤怒，簡單的言語，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_hook.voice_desc_en: Male, middle-aged, Deep, authoritative male voice with a hint of menace, conveying confidence and control; retain character context: Male ruthless killer, cold sharp voice, controlled menace, cruel and confident; visible traits: ruthless, cold, sharp voice; controlled menace; cruel and confident
npc_hook.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，沉穩有權威感，低沉有質感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_hook.ref_zh_text: 寶石發出更亮的光芒，「終於不用再看到你了真好，老頭。也許在來生，我會是你的主人，而你是奴隸。」惡魔發出一聲令人毛骨悚然的輕笑。
npc_hook.ref_en_text: The gem glows brighter, "'Tis good to see the last of thee, also, old man. Perhaps in another life, I shall be thy master, and thou the slave."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: ruthless, cold, sharp voice; controlled menace; cruel and confident
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male ruthless killer, cold sharp voice, controlled menace, cruel and confident
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性冷酷殺手，聲音冰冷銳利、威脅感克制，殘忍而自信，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_horance.voice_desc_en: A mid-40s male with a ghostly, hollow voice, speaking in a slow, distant tone that conveys a sense of stoicism and melancholy; retain character context: Male, ghost, hollow and echoing voice, ethereal and haunting, speaks as if from far away; visible traits: ghostly, hollow eyes, ethereal appearance
npc_horance.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，語速沉穩，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_horance.ref_zh_text: 隨著靈魂囚籠化為塵土，巫妖發生了巨大的轉變。在邪靈被囚禁的地方，你看到了一個熟悉的身影。是 Horance！他是個鬼魂，但他看起來更像個人類，而不是不死生物。
npc_horance.ref_en_text: "I thank thee, milord. That dark spirit had suppressed my will for so long that I was not sure I had one left. Thou hast done a great deed for Skara Brae, for myself and, indeed, all of Britannia, but then I suppose this is merely a matter of course for one such as thee. My gratitude is thine." He bows deeply to you.

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: ghostly, hollow eyes, ethereal appearance
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, ghost, hollow and echoing voice, ethereal and haunting, speaks as if from far away
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男鬼，空洞迴響，空靈縈繞，彷彿從遠方傳來，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_horffe.voice_desc_en: Mid-thirties male with a deep, authoritative voice, conveying seriousness and command; retain character context: Male, gargoyle, serious formal voice; visible traits: stern expression, serious demeanor
npc_horffe.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，沉穩有權威感，低沉有質感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_horffe.ref_zh_text: 「被命令保護居住在 Serpent's Hold 的人民，並維持騎士的整體秩序。」
npc_horffe.ref_en_text: "To inform you that many fine warriors take up residence between the Hold's walls. To have little fear of an attack from bandits or vicious animals."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: stern expression, serious demeanor
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, gargoyle, serious formal voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，嚴肅正式的，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_hydra.voice_desc_en: Deep, gravelly, authoritative tone with a commanding presence; mid-thirties masculine voice; retain character context: Creature, three-headed hydra, deep rumbling growling monster voice; visible traits: deep rumbling growling monster voice
npc_hydra.voice_desc_zh: 生物，中年，沉穩有權威感，低沉有質感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_hydra.ref_zh_text: 「這個生物長得有點像巨魔 (troll) ，只是聞起來稍微好一點。你覺得它會不會比巨魔更好吃， Shando ？」
npc_hydra.ref_en_text: "Now that thou dost mention it, I am feeling a few hunger pangs myself. If we did not have to protect the Caddellite, I would eat this creature in a single gulp!"

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: deep rumbling growling monster voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Creature, three-headed hydra, deep rumbling growling monster voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，低沉的隆隆咆哮的，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_inforlem.voice_desc_en: A middle-aged male voice, smooth and authoritative, with a pleasant tone that conveys warmth and authority; retain character context: Male, gargoyle, cheerful pleasant voice; visible traits: Pleasant expression with a gargoyle-like appearance
npc_inforlem.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，溫暖友善，沉穩有權威感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_inforlem.ref_zh_text: 「告訴你 Forbrak 對 Terfin 和其居民了解很多，而且，」他說，「也了解這裡的衝突。」
npc_inforlem.ref_en_text: "To know of the conflicts between the altars and the Fellowship, but to have no information. To suggest you see Quan, The Fellowship leader here and ask him."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: Pleasant expression with a gargoyle-like appearance
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, gargoyle, cheerful pleasant voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，歡快悅耳的，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_inmanilem.voice_desc_en: Male, elderly, Deep, resonant voice with a gentle warmth, conveying both age and experience; retain character context: Male, gargoyle, friendly helpful voice; visible traits: Friendly gargoyle with horns and glowing eyes
npc_inmanilem.voice_desc_zh: 男性，年長，溫暖友善，低沉有質感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_inmanilem.ref_zh_text: 「告訴你去找 Draxinusom ，人類，或是 Forbrak 。他們有許多關於 Terfin 的情報。」
npc_inmanilem.ref_en_text: "To feel sorry, but to be busy with other things now. To ask you to come back when I have the time to heal you."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: Friendly gargoyle with horns and glowing eyes.
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, gargoyle, friendly helpful voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，友善樂於助人的，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_inwisloklem.voice_desc_en: Male, elderly, Deep, resonant voice with a slow, deliberate pace, conveying wisdom and authority; retain character context: Male, gargoyle, intelligent wise voice; visible traits: Winged gargoyle with intelligent expression
npc_inwisloklem.voice_desc_zh: 男性，年長，低沉有質感，語速沉穩，帶有智慧與閱歷，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_inwisloklem.ref_zh_text: 「是個孤寂的地方。很荒涼。不是人類所謂的『舒適家園』。渴望在 Britannia 為石像鬼建立一種新的生活方式，並消除人類對我們種族的仇恨和誤解。知道無知會滋生偏見。而我是正在糾正這點的其中一人。」
npc_inwisloklem.ref_en_text: "To be a lonely place. To be desolate. To be not what humans call `homey'. To desire to establish a new way of life for gargoyles in Britannia, and to eliminate the hatred and misunderstanding of our race in humans. To know that ignorance breeds bigotry. To be one of those who are correcting this."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: Winged gargoyle with intelligent expression
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, gargoyle, intelligent wise voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，聰明智慧的，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_iolo.voice_desc_en: Warm, elderly male voice with a gentle chuckle, conveying wisdom and authority while maintaining a friendly tone; retain character context: Male, elderly, warm and friendly companion, wise old soul with a gentle chuckle in his voice; visible traits: wise old soul with a gentle chuckle in his voice
npc_iolo.voice_desc_zh: 男性，年長，溫暖友善，帶有智慧與閱歷，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_iolo.ref_zh_text: 聖者 注意到這些十字弓箭上獨特的 Iolo 商標了嗎？它們是專為真正的 IOLO 十字弓提供最大效能而設計的，在 Yew 附近有售。
npc_iolo.ref_en_text: Oh, but Avatar! Wait until I tell the others! They will be happy to see thee! Welcome to Trinsic!

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: wise old soul with a gentle chuckle in his voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.temperament: warm and friendly companion; wise and authoritative
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, elderly, warm and friendly companion, wise old soul with a gentle chuckle in his voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，年長，熱情友善，明智的老靈魂，裡帶著溫柔的笑聲，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_iskander.voice_desc_en: Middle-aged, masculine voice with deep resonance and slow, deliberate pace. Warmth is present in the tone despite the irritation; retain character context: Male, cyclops, deep booming voice, slow and simple speech; visible traits: large cyclops with a single eye
npc_iskander.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，溫暖友善，低沉有質感，語速沉穩，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_iskander.ref_zh_text: 「我知道 Eiko 和 Amanda 一直在追捕我尋求復仇。我說讓她們來吧。我不會站在原地等她們，也不會逃避她們。當她們找到我時，歡迎她們試著從我這裡討回她們的正義。如果她們贏了，那也是命中注定。如果她們輸了，我也沒有遺憾。」
npc_iskander.ref_en_text: "I know that Eiko and Amanda have been after me for some time looking for vengeance. I say let them come. I will not stand still for them nor shall I run from them. When they find me they are welcome to try and take their justice from me. If they win then it was meant to be. If they do not I will have no regrets."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: large cyclops with a single eye
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, cyclops, deep booming voice, slow and simple speech
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，低沉洪亮，言語緩慢而簡單，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_jaana.voice_desc_en: A soothing, mature female voice with a gentle cadence and a touch of authority, conveying wisdom and tranquility; retain character context: Female, 40s, wise druidess, calm and spiritual voice, gentle authority; visible traits: wisdom, calmness, spiritual presence
npc_jaana.voice_desc_zh: 女性，中年，溫暖友善，柔和，帶有智慧與閱歷，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_jaana.ref_zh_text: 你很驚訝地看到你的老同伴 Jaana ，自從你上次造訪以來，她看起來只有稍微老了一點。
npc_jaana.ref_en_text: "My magic has been affected by something in the air, but I have found that my senses are still with me. Hast thou noticed that the mages in the land are afflicted in the head? It is most disconcerting. Nevertheless, I can manage to cast a spell or two most of the time."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: wisdom, calmness, spiritual presence
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Female, 40s, wise druidess, calm and spiritual voice, gentle authority
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 女，40多歲，沉靜有靈性，溫柔的權威，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_jehanne.voice_desc_en: A mature female voice with a refined tone, speaking in a polite manner with a slight accent, conveying warmth and authority; retain character context: Female, 40s, noblewoman, refined polite voice, curtsy in speech; visible traits: noblewoman with refined features, wearing a red dress and gold jewelry
npc_jehanne.voice_desc_zh: 女性，中年，溫暖友善，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_jehanne.ref_zh_text: 「不久前，我的 Pendaran 還是一位高貴的騎士，一位女士可以為之驕傲的騎士。但現在，」她搖搖頭，「為了抗議他認為不列顛尼亞政府的錯誤，他毀壞了我們敬愛的 Lord British 的雕像。」她開始啜泣。
npc_jehanne.ref_en_text: "Well, it was once the magnificent `Constellation.' However, 'twas destroyed by the ship's captain, himself, to prevent it from falling into the hands of attacking pirates. What little remained was rebuilt into an even finer ship, `The Dragon's Breath?' Art thou interested in purchasing it for 600 gold?"

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: noblewoman with refined features, wearing a red dress and gold jewelry.
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Female, 40s, noblewoman, refined polite voice, curtsy in speech
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 女性，40多歲，優雅有禮貌，說話行屈膝禮，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_jesse.voice_desc_en: Deep, authoritative voice with a hint of theatrical flair, conveying confidence and warmth; retain character context: Male, 20s-30s, tall thin actor, theatrical voice, doing female roles; visible traits: tall, thin with knobby knees, wearing a woman's wig in drag
npc_jesse.voice_desc_zh: 男性，20-40歲，溫暖友善，活潑有戲劇感，沉穩有權威感，低沉有質感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_jesse.ref_zh_text: 「這個角色極具挑戰性。我有過多的台詞，而且我必須和訓練員一起工作好幾週，為所需的大量活動做準備。這個角色會讓『Jesse』家喻戶曉！」
npc_jesse.ref_en_text: "My favorite piece is something Raymundo wrote for me entitled 'Three on a Codpiece'. I stand on stage and invite the audience to join me in tearing an undergarment into tiny pieces, after which they are placed in funeral urns and mixed with wheat paste. The pieces of cloth, not the audience members. Then the audience may glue the pieces anywhere on my body that they wish."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: tall, thin with knobby knees, wearing a woman's wig in drag
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, 20s-30s, tall thin actor, theatrical voice, doing female roles
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，20-30歲，活潑有戲劇感，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_john_paul.voice_desc_en: Deep and resonant, conveying authority while maintaining a friendly tone; retain character context: Male, 40s, serious military commander, firm and authoritative voice; visible traits: serious with half-smile, military attire
npc_john_paul.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，溫暖友善，沉穩有權威感，低沉有質感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_john_paul.ref_zh_text: 「哦，我明白了。好吧，既然如此。最好的開始方式是去跟神聖碼頭的酒館老闆 Denton 爵士談談。他解決謎題和問題的能力非常卓越。解開這個小謎團後，請帶著你的發現來找我。」
npc_john_paul.ref_en_text: "Oh, I see. Well, in that case. The best way to begin is by speaking with Sir Denton, the tavernkeeper at the Hallowed Dock. His ability to solve puzzles and problems is remarkable. Please come to me with thy findings after thou hast solved this little mystery."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: serious with half-smile, military attire
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, serious military commander, firm and authoritative voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，堅定而權威，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_joseph.voice_desc_en: A mature male voice, authoritative but warm, conveying experience and respect; retain character context: Male, 20s-30s, capable young administrator, polite efficient voice; visible traits: respected administrator with a polished demeanor
npc_joseph.voice_desc_zh: 男性，20-40歲，溫暖友善，沉穩有權威感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_joseph.ref_zh_text: 「當我說 De Snel 會向我挑戰決鬥時，我並不是在暗示那會是一場公平或光榮的比賽——更可能是我走在某條暗巷時，被他手下的某個惡霸從背後捅一刀。所謂的決鬥只是他用來讓暗殺我這件事聽起來光榮一點的說詞。」
npc_joseph.ref_en_text: "When I say that De Snel would challenge me to a duel I do not mean to insinuate that it would in any way be a fair or honorable contest-- more like a dagger in the back from one of his bullies as I was walking down a dark alley somewhere. That it would be a duel is just the story he would tell to make mine assassination somehow honorable."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: respected administrator with a polished demeanor.
_portrait_voice_analysis.temperament: authoritative yet approachable, exuding confidence and experience.
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, 20s-30s, capable young administrator, polite efficient voice

npc_judith.voice_desc_en: Warm, slightly hurried female voice with a musical texture, conveying both enthusiasm and authority; retain character context: Female, 40s, musician, warm musical voice, hurried performer; visible traits: warm musical voice with a hint of urgency in her speech
npc_judith.voice_desc_zh: 女性，中年，溫暖友善，活潑有戲劇感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_judith.ref_zh_text: 「我們是一個合唱團。我們每晚在藍野豬酒館表演。請來聽我們的演出！我的學生 Neno 也在團裡。如果我們能籌到資金，我們希望明年能在全國巡迴演出。」
npc_judith.ref_en_text: "We are a singing group. We play at the Blue Boar every evening. Please come and hear us! My pupil, Neno, is in the group. We hope to tour the country next year, if we can raise the funds."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: warm musical voice with a hint of urgency in her speech.

npc_julia.voice_desc_en: A confident female voice in her late twenties, with a bright and engaging tone that conveys enthusiasm and warmth; retain character context: Female, 20s-30s, clever tinker, bright and enthusiastic voice, quick; visible traits: bright and enthusiastic
npc_julia.voice_desc_zh: 女性，20-30歲，溫暖友善，語氣有活力，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_julia.ref_zh_text: 你看到了 Julia ，她是你之前某次造訪 Britannia 時冒險隊伍的成員。
npc_julia.ref_en_text: You see Julia, a member of your party of adventurers from one of your previous visits to Britannia.

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: bright and enthusiastic

npc_kallibrus.voice_desc_en: A middle-aged male with a reserved demeanor and a gentle, authoritative tone that conveys both caution and warmth; retain character context: Male, gargoyle, reserved shy voice; visible traits: Reserved, gargoyle-like appearance with a subtle smile
npc_kallibrus.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，溫暖友善，沉穩有權威感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_kallibrus.ref_zh_text: 「曾聽 Cosmo 說過『愛』，但 Cairbre 聲稱沒有這種東西。不明白，但無論如何都會幫助朋友。」
npc_kallibrus.ref_en_text: "To be related to difference in genders, I know, but to see no such thing in gargoyles. To believe there is a certain human... woman... who sent him here.

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: Reserved, gargoyle-like appearance with a subtle smile.
_portrait_voice_analysis.temperament: Cautious yet friendly, with a hint of wisdom in his voice.
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, gargoyle, reserved shy voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男，內斂害羞，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_katrina.voice_desc_en: Warm, gentle female voice with a slight twang, conveying kindness and maternal care at a steady pace; retain character context: Female, 40s, warm shepherdess, kind maternal voice, gentle and nurturing
npc_katrina.voice_desc_zh: 女性，中年，溫暖友善，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_katrina.ref_zh_text: 你看到了你的老同伴 Katrina ，她看起來只比你上次造訪時見到她稍微老了一點。
npc_katrina.ref_en_text: "Henry has been a very dear friend for years. He is a simple but good man who does not have an ounce of hate in his heart for anyone. I am so fond of him that I gave him a valuable heirloom."

_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Female, 40s, warm shepherdess, kind maternal voice, gentle and nurturing
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 女，40多歲，慈母的溫柔有教養，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_kessler.voice_desc_en: A deep, resonant voice with a slight rasp, conveying authority and warmth in a measured pace; retain character context: Male, elderly, authoritative older man, dignified concerned voice; visible traits: authoritative, thoughtful concern
npc_kessler.voice_desc_zh: 男性，年長，溫暖友善，沉穩有權威感，低沉有質感，語速沉穩，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_kessler.ref_zh_text: 「我們對我們使用的大多數物質的影響仍然知之甚少。許多物質引起的問題比解決的還多，或者如果與其他元素一起服用，會產生不同的反應。有些可能會讓你對健康產生依賴，有些則可能根本就是有毒的。」
npc_kessler.ref_en_text: "We still know very little about the effects of most of the substances we use. Many cause more problems than they solve, or react differently if taken in unison with other elements. Some might cause thee to become dependent on them for thine health and some may simply be poisonous."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: authoritative, thoughtful concern
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, elderly, authoritative older man, dignified concerned voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，老人，權威的老人，威嚴關切的，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_kissme.voice_desc_en: A youthful, high-pitched voice with a gentle, playful tone, conveying warmth and sincerity; retain character context: Female, fairy, high-pitched tinkling voice, playful and giggly, singsong quality; visible traits: fairy-like with sparkling dust
npc_kissme.voice_desc_zh: 女性，小孩，溫暖友善，活潑有戲劇感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_kissme.ref_zh_text: 這個活潑的小仙子 (fairy) 在你周圍飛舞，咯咯笑著在你的頭上撒下某種閃閃發光的粉末。
npc_kissme.ref_en_text: "The hydra is made up of three brothers -- all dragons! It is true! Thou shalt be careful not to make them angry, for they have a temper! Oh, yes indeed, they do! They are very protective of their Caddellite, so speak to them about it first!"

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: fairy-like with sparkling dust
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Female, fairy, high-pitched tinkling voice, playful and giggly, singsong quality
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 女，高亢叮噹，俏皮傻笑，歌聲品質，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_kliftin.voice_desc_en: A deep, gravelly voice with a hint of weariness and experience, conveying authority while maintaining warmth; retain character context: Male, elderly, scarred veteran, gruff experienced voice; visible traits: battle-scarred, veteran
npc_kliftin.voice_desc_zh: 男性，年長，溫暖友善，低沉有質感，帶有智慧與閱歷，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_kliftin.ref_zh_text: 你向這位全神貫注聽著的老人講述 Sprellic 的故事。「聽起來像是騙子 Sullivan 的傑作。他是一個從未被抓到過的傳奇小偷和騙子！甚至很少有人相信他真的存在。你不可能用那樣的故事來勸阻決鬥者。」
npc_kliftin.ref_en_text: You relate Sprellic's story to the old man who listens intently. "It sounds to me like the work of Sullivan, the Trickster. He is a legendary thief and swindler who has never once been caught! Indeed, few even believe he actually exists. Thou shalt not be able to dissuade the duellists with a tale like that."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: battle-scarred, veteran
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, elderly, scarred veteran, gruff experienced voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，年長，傷痕累累的退伍軍人，粗魯經驗豐富的，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_klog.voice_desc_en: A mature male voice with a warm, genial tone, conveying kindness and authority suitable for a friendly shopkeeper; retain character context: Male, 40s, friendly shopkeeper, warm and welcoming voice, cheerful; visible traits: Warm and genial with a friendly demeanor
npc_klog.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，溫暖友善，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_klog.ref_zh_text: 這個男人散發著友善和親切的氣息。「啊，聖者！我一眼就認出你了！消息在鎮上傳得很快。我已經聽說你在這裡了。
npc_klog.ref_en_text: "I am certain you are all sorely aware of the crimes that have been committed in our city. Now is a time to mourn those whom we have lost. We will always remember Christopher, our blacksmith, as a valuable citizen of our town as well as a dear friend. Inamo was an amiable and hard-working gargoyle. As their deaths show us, Britannia needs The Fellowship now more than ever.

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: Warm and genial with a friendly demeanor.
_portrait_voice_analysis.temperament: Kind and welcoming, exuding confidence in his role as a shopkeeper.
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, friendly shopkeeper, warm and welcoming voice, cheerful
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，熱情好客，個性開朗，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_lap_lem.voice_desc_en: Warm, mid-range male voice with a friendly tone, smooth texture, moderate pace, and a touch of regality; retain character context: Male, gargoyle, smiling friendly voice; visible traits: smiling, gargoyle-like features with green eyes and red fur
npc_lap_lem.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，溫暖友善，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_lap_lem.ref_zh_text: 「告訴你還有另一個—— Anmanivas 。因為種族仇恨而離開了。現在整天和兄弟 Foranamo 坐在酒館裡。為 Anmanivas 和他兄弟感到難過，但需要工作。」他聳聳肩。
npc_lap_lem.ref_en_text: "To tell you that there was another -- Anmanivas. To have left because of racial hatred. To sit now in tavern all day with brother, Foranamo. To feel bad for Anmanivas and brother, but to need job." He shrugs.

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: smiling, gargoyle-like features with green eyes and red fur
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, gargoyle, smiling friendly voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，微笑友善的，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_lasher.voice_desc_en: A mid-40s male voice, noble and wise, clear and articulate, with a magical quality that conveys authority and calmness; retain character context: Male, unicorn, noble and wise voice, clear and articulate, magical quality; visible traits: noble and wise appearance with a single straight horn and glowing eyes
npc_lasher.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，帶有智慧與閱歷，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_lasher.ref_zh_text: 你看到一隻大小和形狀都像馬的生物。牠的頭上長著一根筆直的角。牠用閃爍著智慧光芒的眼睛看著你。
npc_lasher.ref_en_text: "Where was I? Oh, yes, Sharp-Hoof! The next morning, after we had had our way with these fillies, this wizard called us again. This time Sharp-Hoof realized that we had best answer, and were we sorry that we did! The wizard was horribly angry! And, well, I will just say that our agreements with such people are very, very binding."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: noble and wise appearance with a single straight horn and glowing eyes
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, unicorn, noble and wise voice, clear and articulate, magical quality
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男，高貴睿智的清晰能說，神奇品質，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_leavell.voice_desc_en: A deep, resonant voice with a hint of youthful confidence and a touch of authority; retain character context: Male, 20s, knife-juggler, dangerous calm voice, focused; visible traits: sharp focus, confident demeanor
npc_leavell.voice_desc_zh: 男性，20-30歲，低沉有質感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_leavell.ref_zh_text: 「當 Robin 少爺無法償還債務時，『先生』派了他的打手 Sintag 和他的無賴們來追捕我們。我們不得不搭乘第一艘離開海盜巢穴 (Buccaneer's Den)的船。我不知道他為什麼被稱為『先生』。」
npc_leavell.ref_en_text: You see a young man balancing a dagger on the tip of his finger. He tries hard to ignore you.

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: sharp focus, confident demeanor
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, 20s, knife-juggler, dangerous calm voice, focused
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，20多歲，危險平靜的專注，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_lord_british.voice_desc_en: Deep, resonant voice, measured pace, authoritative tone, dignified delivery; retain character context: Male, elderly, regal and authoritative king, deep resonant voice, dignified and measured pace; visible traits: regal attire with a crown, stern expression
npc_lord_british.voice_desc_zh: 男性，年長，沉穩有權威感，低沉有質感，語速沉穩，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_lord_british.ref_zh_text: 「當然，這也許可以看作是解決我們所有問題的聰明辦法。畢竟，現在就連那個所謂的守護者也不會想要 Britannia 了！
npc_lord_british.ref_en_text: The king pauses a moment. "Now that thou dost mention it, I have had reports of other similar murders in the past few months. In fact, there was one here in Britain three or four years ago. The body was mutilated in a ritualistic fashion. Apparently there is a maddened killer on the loose. But I have no doubt that someone such as thee, Avatar, can find him!"

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: regal attire with a crown, stern expression
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, elderly, regal and authoritative king, deep resonant voice, dignified and measured pace
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，老人，低沉，步伐威嚴，穩重，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_lord_heather.voice_desc_en: Warm and polished, with a touch of authority and charm, conveying confidence in a steady pace; retain character context: Male, 40s-50s, lordly politician, charming public voice; visible traits: regal, well-dressed, confident
npc_lord_heather.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，溫暖友善，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_lord_heather.ref_zh_text: 「嗯，讓我想想……我愛上了我們的治療師 Jaana。當然，她也愛我。然後是經營翡翠酒館的 Zinaida。她對我們當地的吟遊詩人 De Maria 有好感。反之亦然。我們的訓練師 Rayburt 正在追求旅店老闆 Pamela。」
npc_lord_heather.ref_en_text: "Well, let's see... I am in love with Jaana, our healer. And she is in love with me, of course. Then there is Zinaida, who runs the Emerald. She has an interest in De Maria, our local bard. And vice versa. Rayburt, our trainer, is courting Pamela, the innkeeper."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: regal, well-dressed, confident
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, 40s-50s, lordly politician, charming public voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，40-50歲，迷人的公眾，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_lucky.voice_desc_en: Deep and resonant, with a steady pace and authoritative tone that conveys confidence; retain character context: Male, 30s-40s, steel-muscled pirate, confident smug voice; visible traits: sinewy body like steel, glint in the eye
npc_lucky.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，沉穩有權威感，低沉有質感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_lucky.ref_zh_text: 「只要憑藉假設，你就能成為另一個人。這是一種態度。我是為了欺騙而進行充滿魅力的溝通藝術的專家。它賦予人許多技能。舉例來說，我可以走進任何一家店買東西。但我離開時帶走的東西會比我買的多得多，因為我知道如何欺騙店主。就像那樣的小事。」
npc_lucky.ref_en_text: You see a man whose sinewy body is like steel. The glint in his eye tells you that he is no fool.

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: sinewy body like steel, glint in the eye
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, 30s-40s, steel-muscled pirate, confident smug voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，自信得意的，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_lucy.voice_desc_en: Warm and inviting voice, slightly authoritative, smooth texture, moderate pace, conveys charm and warmth; retain character context: Female, 50s, charming older woman, warm welcoming voice, excited; visible traits: warm smile, attractive woman in her fifties
npc_lucy.voice_desc_zh: 女性，中年，溫暖友善，沉穩有權威感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_lucy.ref_zh_text: 你看見一位五十多歲、頗具魅力的女人。她帶著溫暖的微笑。「歡迎！陌生人，你是誰？
npc_lucy.ref_en_text: You see an attractive woman in her fifties. She has a warm smile. "Welcome! Who art thou, stranger?

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: warm smile, attractive woman in her fifties
_portrait_voice_analysis.temperament: charming, warm, welcoming with a hint of authority
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Female, 50s, charming older woman, warm welcoming voice, excited
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 女性，50多歲，熱情歡迎的興奮，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_mack.voice_desc_en: Warm, enthusiastic male voice with a rustic charm and slightly elevated pitch to convey excitement; retain character context: Male, 40s, excited farmer, wild-eyed enthusiastic voice; visible traits: wild eyes widened in excitement
npc_mack.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，溫暖友善，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_mack.ref_zh_text: 「嗯，也不是真的不見了。它被鎖在我的棚子裡。不見的是棚子的鑰匙！我想我可能在 Lock Lake 岸邊釣魚時不小心把它當成魚鉤用了。所以現在我進不去我的棚子了。人家還真會以為我是個瘋子呢！」
npc_mack.ref_en_text: "Well, 'tis not really lost. It is locked up in my shed. It is the key to the shed that is lost! I think I might have accidentally used it as a fishhook when I was fishing on the banks of Lock Lake. So now I cannot get into my shed. One would think I -am- a looney!"

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: wild eyes widened in excitement
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, excited farmer, wild-eyed enthusiastic voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，眼神狂熱熱情的，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_magenta.voice_desc_en: A gentle, elderly woman with a soft, soothing tone and a touch of authority in her delivery; retain character context: Female, elderly, humble old woman, soft friendly voice; visible traits: humble, friendly smile, soft voice
npc_magenta.voice_desc_zh: 女性，年長，溫暖友善，柔和，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_magenta.ref_zh_text: 「我絕不可能戴著原本要送給別的女人的珠寶。作為鎮長，聖者，我將把它還給她（或者更確切地說，還給本來打算送她的人）的任務交給你。至於 Boris ……哼，我晚點再來收拾他！」
npc_magenta.ref_en_text: "I cannot possibly wear a piece of jewelry meant for another woman. As mayor, I charge thee, Avatar, with the task of returning it to her, or more properly to the person who had intended to give it to her. As for Boris... well, I shall deal with him later!"

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: humble, friendly smile, soft voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Female, elderly, humble old woman, soft friendly voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 女性，年長，謙虛，溫柔友善的，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_malloy.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, pompous miner, self-important voice, grand speech
npc_malloy.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，自然清晰，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_malloy.ref_zh_text: 你看到面前站著一個矮胖的男人，臉上帶著自命不凡的傻笑。他一手拿著燈籠，另一手拿著一把髒湯匙。
npc_malloy.ref_en_text: "We paid nearly a hundred gold pieces for that map. It was supposed to lead to a spot of valuable minerals found over a hundred years ago. It was a terrific investment. The map was an antique, but it looked like it could not have been more than a few years old! Thou dost not see preservation like that every day!"

npc_mandy.voice_desc_en: Warm, authoritative female voice, mid-tempo delivery, slightly rough texture, conveys both toughness and maternal warmth; retain character context: Female, 50s, tough barmaid, rough but motherly voice, no-nonsense; visible traits: tough barmaid with a motherly quality
npc_mandy.voice_desc_zh: 女性，中年，溫暖友善，沉穩有權威感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_mandy.ref_zh_text: 你看到一位五十多歲的女人，她早年可能是個海盜侍女。雖然她很粗野，但她有一種特別的母性特質。
npc_mandy.ref_en_text: "Yes, I have run this tavern and inn since my wenching days." Mandy laughs. "I was quite a beauty back then, but thou canst not tell it now. I know everyone in town and they all know me. If thou dost need to know something about anyone, let me know."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: tough barmaid with a motherly quality
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Female, 50s, tough barmaid, rough but motherly voice, no-nonsense
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 女性，50多歲，粗獷但充滿母性，嚴肅，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_margareta.voice_desc_en: Warm and authoritative, with a deep, resonant tone that conveys wisdom and mystery; retain character context: Female, 20s-30s, gypsy, wise mysterious voice, deep knowing tone; visible traits: bewitching gypsy woman with wise eyes
npc_margareta.voice_desc_zh: 女性，20-30歲，溫暖友善，沉穩有權威感，低沉有質感，帶有智慧與閱歷，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_margareta.ref_zh_text: 「我看到你戴著他們的一個護身符，但你並不是真正的成員，對吧？小心點——友誼會裡有些人會看穿你的偽裝。」
npc_margareta.ref_en_text: "I see thou art vearing vone ov their medallions, but thou art not truly a member, art thou? Bevare -- there are those in The Fellowship that vill see through thy deception."

npc_martine.ref_en_text: Martine smiles. "That is just fine with me, honey. I would wager thou hast many stories to tell about adventuring, yes? Say! npc_miranda.ref_en_text: "That is good news! Perhaps thou couldst do us a great favor. We need this bill delivered to Lord Heather in Cove. He must read it and give us his approval by signing it. I know thou hast far more important things to do than running errands, but it would be greatly appreciated. Wilt thou do it?"

npc_mole.ref_zh_text: 「Blacktooth 住在這裡的島上。我們曾經是同一條鍊子上的環節，懂我的意思嗎？但自從我加入友誼會後，他就把我當空氣！他表現得好像我得了瘟疫什麼的。我不明白。讓我想把什麼東西切成肉末！」
npc_mole.ref_en_text: "Well, he is not a brother now! He hates me! If he wants nothing to do with me, so be it!" But Mole quickly adds, "He does not realize what I did for him. I made his life livable! Who was it that nursed him when he had scurvy? Me! Who was it that patched him up when he was sliced to bits by that butcher Silverbeard? Me!"

npc_morfin.ref_zh_text: 你看到一個男人，他的眼珠慢慢地轉來轉去，嘴角掛著狡黠的微笑。他走到你面前，上下打量著你。「喔，鎮上一定有巡迴表演！」他竊笑著說。「那是一件非常棒的小丑裝！你是誰？

npc_nastassia.ref_en_text: The woman raises her arms to the sky and cries out, "Didst thou hear that, mother? Thine husband was only trying to provide for his family! And he died... a hero! He was not a vagabond! Dost thou hear? Thou canst rest thy tortured soul now. Please, mother, forgive him. Do so, so that I can now forgive thee."

npc_neno.ref_zh_text: 「我正在學習成為 Britannia 有史以來最偉大的吟遊詩人。我可能 -已經- 是 Britannia 有史以來最偉大的吟遊詩人了。」你注意到 Neno 一點也不謙虛。
npc_neno.ref_en_text: "'Tis a singing group I play with. We play at The Blue Boar every evening. Please, come listen to us." Neno leans in to whisper, "But I plan to begin performing alone very soon. I am obviously the most talented member of the quartet."

npc_nicodemus.ref_zh_text: 「這是一個非常好的問題。有些日子我真的能記得。讓我想想……今天……對！我是 Nicodemus ！ Nicodomus ！ Nicodimus ！ Nico-nico-kukodamus ！哈 哈 哈！」
npc_nicodemus.ref_en_text: "Potions? What makes thee think I have potions? Art thou sure thou dost not want Lotions? I certainly have lotions! Otions, slotions, motions, votions! Ha ha ha! Wait! Oh, yes! I do have potions! I told thee so, didn't I! Let us see... I have this black potion here. I am not sure what it does exactly, but I am quite sure it turns one invisible.

npc_nystul.ref_en_text: "Well, I used to perform quite a bit of magic," he says apologetically. "At least... I -think- I used to do so. There is a man named Lord British, I think. I work for him."

npc_ophelia.voice_desc_en: Warm, mature female voice, gentle yet authoritative, with a touch of playfulness in her tone; retain character context: Female, 20s, shy and kind young woman, soft gentle voice, sweet and warm; visible traits: pretty woman with friendly grin, coy eyes
npc_ophelia.voice_desc_zh: 女性，20-30歲，溫暖友善，活潑有戲劇感，沉穩有權威感，柔和，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_ophelia.ref_zh_text: 「自從老闆 Sprellic 被傷痕圖書館的那三個學生挑戰決鬥後，他就一直忙著準備。我一直獨自經營這個地方……我想 Daphne 也算是有幫忙啦。」
npc_ophelia.ref_en_text: "Ever since Sprellic, the owner, was challenged to those duels by the three students at the Library of Scars, he has been busy preparing himself. I have been running the place all by myself... although Daphne has been helping me, I suppose."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: pretty woman with friendly grin, coy eyes
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Female, 20s, shy and kind young woman, soft gentle voice, sweet and warm

npc_owen.voice_desc_en: A mature male with a commanding but respectful tone, speaking at a steady pace with clear diction and a touch of formality; retain character context: Male, 20s, serious young nobleman, earnest and formal voice; visible traits: formal attire, serious demeanor
npc_owen.voice_desc_zh: 男性，20-30歲，沉穩有權威感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_owen.ref_zh_text: 「顯然，建造史上最偉大的航行船隻以及為 Minoc 所做的一切已經不夠了！不！多虧了那個自大白痴的鎮長，我被剝奪了理應屬於我的致敬，我早就證明我完全受之無愧。設計缺陷，呸！Burnside 鎮長在他那悲慘的一生中到底造過幾艘船？！」
npc_owen.ref_en_text: "This was the voice of reason within mine own mind which sought to guide my life in its proper direction. The Fellowship taught me how to trust this voice and heed what it says. And thou canst see the results in mine own life! I have mastered my craft and advanced the techniques of ship-building through the methods I have devised."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: formal attire, serious demeanor

npc_owings.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, skinny miner, friendly simple voice, grinning
npc_owings.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，溫暖友善，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_owings.ref_zh_text: 在你面前的是個骨瘦如柴的男人，臉上帶著傻笑。他一手拿著燈籠，另一手拿著一把髒湯匙。
npc_owings.ref_en_text: It appears Malloy can no longer stand being left out of the conversation. "It was -mine- idea to send Lord British the helmet," he says proudly. "While we have not yet heard back from him about it I am sure he will find some way to thank us." Malloy's helmet falls off and he stands there a long time before regaining the composure to pick it up again.

npc_papa.voice_desc_en: Male, 40s-50s, wild naked man, rough primal voice, baffled
npc_papa.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，自然清晰，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_papa.ref_zh_text: 「沒錯。我的真名是 Murray。Mama 其實是 Myrtle。我原本是鎮上的一名持有完整執照的藥劑師，直到不列顛尼亞稅務委員會找上我。他們想把我剝個精光，所以我就把衣服都給他們了！
npc_papa.ref_en_text: "Since then, Myrtle and I prefer to live down here with the bees. Life is so... carefree down here. We have chosen to live with nature. Now, if thou dost not mind, I shall isolate myself from thee and bid thee farewell."

npc_patterson.voice_desc_en: A middle-aged man with a serious and somewhat anxious tone, speaking in a steady, deliberate manner to convey his focus on the Fellowship meeting; retain character context: Male, 30s-40s, concerned fellowship member, worried and distracted voice; visible traits: serious, focused expression
npc_patterson.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，沉穩有權威感，語速沉穩，帶有憂慮感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_patterson.ref_zh_text: 「我有這麼說嗎？我絕對不是那個意思。 Britain 已經沒有階級制度了，整個國家也都沒有！我的意思是『農民階級』，也就是那些沒有優越血統的人—— Brownie 就是那種人——『他們』也不支持他。他們知道誰會是最好的領導者！」
npc_patterson.ref_en_text: "Did I say that? I certainly did not mean it. There is no class system in Britain anymore, nor in the entire country, for that matter! What I meant is that the 'peasantry', that is, those people who are not of superior lineage -- which is the type of man Brownie is -- -they- did not support him either. They knew who would be the best leader!"

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: serious, focused expression
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, 30s-40s, concerned fellowship member, worried and distracted voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，關心的擔憂而心煩意亂的，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_paul.voice_desc_en: A confident, youthful male with a warm and engaging tone, conveying enthusiasm without being overly energetic; retain character context: Male, 20s, cheerful young performer, bright and energetic voice; visible traits: confident, expressive, youthful
npc_paul.voice_desc_zh: 男性，20-30歲，溫暖友善，活潑有戲劇感，語氣有活力，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_paul.ref_zh_text: 「他們說的那個聲音是什麼意思？我不確定我聽得懂。這真是一齣令人困惑的戲。我一點也不喜歡。我們浪費了時間和金錢！這是我最後一次讓你來決定我們該怎麼娛樂自己了！」
npc_paul.ref_en_text: "What do they mean about the voice? I am not sure I understand. 'Twas a confusing play. I did not like it at all. We have wasted our time and money! That is the last time that I let thee decide how best we entertain ourselves!"

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: confident, expressive, youthful

npc_paulette.voice_desc_en: A soft, gentle female voice with a calm and serene tone, conveying an otherworldly presence; retain character context: Female, 20s, beautiful barmaid ghost, dreamy distant voice, confused; visible traits: dreamy, distant, ghostly appearance
npc_paulette.voice_desc_zh: 女性，20-30歲，溫暖友善，柔和，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_paulette.ref_zh_text: 「哦，是的。太可怕了！酒館起火了。我跑到我的房間，希望能逃離火焰。但後來我開始咳嗽。我無法呼吸。」她的胸口快速起伏，彷彿正在重溫那段經歷。
npc_paulette.ref_en_text: "Oh, yes. It was horrible! The tavern caught on fire. I ran to my room, hoping to escape the flames. But then I started coughing. I couldn't breathe." Her chest rises and falls quickly as if she's reliving the experience.

npc_petre.ref_en_text: "The Mayor did not let me clean in there until twenty-four hours after thou didst leave Trinsic. He thought we had to keep the place of the crime unsullied. Well, if thou dost ask me, I can tell thee that it still stinks like the end of the world in there!"

npc_phearcy.ref_en_text: Sorry, milord, I may talk to thee later. But now I wish to pay attention to the meeting.

npc_quaeven.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，沉穩有權威感，低沉有質感，語速沉穩，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_quaeven.ref_zh_text: 「在財務和個人層面上支持 Paws 的救濟院。在 Britannia 舉辦宴會和節慶來提振士氣。是所有石像鬼和人類都非常需要的團體。我自己也需要友誼會！」
npc_quaeven.ref_en_text: "To support financially and personally a poorhouse in Paws. To organize feasts and festivals in Britannia to help morale. To be a much needed group by all gargoyles and men. To have needed The Fellowship myself!"

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: serious, stern, authoritative

npc_quan.ref_en_text: "To have succumbed to the effects of disease and famine that have recently struck Britannia. To tell you that gargoyles breed less frequently, and we have not had the time to make up for losses in our population.

npc_quenton.ref_zh_text: 蒼白的幽靈似乎看到了你，但出於某種原因無法對你說話。幽靈沮喪地轉過身去。
npc_quenton.ref_en_text: "It seems that Mistress Mordra, the town healer, thought she had a plan to stop the Liche, Horance, which she told to the Mayor. I am not sure exactly what she planned, but it involved Trent, the town smith, and Caine, the alchemist. Not long after Caine began his work, a maelstrom of fire tore over the island, destroying everything. Skara Brae burned for days."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: pale ghost with weak fading voice

npc_rankin.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，溫暖友善，沉穩有權威感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_rankin.ref_zh_text: 「我不會讓你太擔心這件事的，聖者。恐怕 Balayna 有點太野心勃勃了。我猜她可能是無意中聽到了我的一場演講，並且誤解了我的話。等我有更多時間時，我必須和她談談這件事，以便消除她的恐懼。」他睜大眼睛，彷彿想起了什麼。
npc_rankin.ref_en_text: "I would not let it worry thee too much, Avatar. I am afraid Balayna is a bit too ambitious. I would expect she overheard one of my conversion speeches and misunderstood my words. I will have to discuss this with her when I have more time so I may allay her fears." His eyes widen, as if he is remembering something.

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: friendly, approachable, slightly formal

npc_raymundo.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，溫暖友善，沉穩有權威感，低沉有質感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_raymundo.ref_zh_text: 手裡拿著長杖，你再次嘗試了台詞。這一次，你覺得自己像個真正的演員。台詞從你的雙唇間流瀉而出，彷彿真的是聖者在說話一樣。你感受到了一股前所未有的興奮。你喜歡上了「演戲」這件事。你渴望更多！你焦急地等待著 Raymundo 的講評……
npc_raymundo.ref_en_text: With the staff in hand, you try the lines once more. This time you feel like a true actor. The lines flow from your lips as if the Avatar were really saying them. You feel an excitement you have never before felt. You like this 'acting' thing. You crave more! You anxiously await Raymundo's critique...

npc_reyna.voice_desc_en: Warm, confident female voice in her 30s, with a lively and engaging tone that conveys warmth and authority; retain character context: Female, 20s-30s, bright-eyed woman, cheerful and lively voice; visible traits: bright-eyed woman with a cheerful demeanor

npc_reyna.ref_zh_text: 「這就是這個區域——人神修道院——名字的由來，得名於住在玫瑰友誼會修道院裡的僧侶。據說他們釀的酒很美味。其中一位僧侶在閒暇時照料著一個美麗的花園。事實上，我經常向她買花。
npc_reyna.ref_en_text: "I wanted to live and work here because the land is very beautiful. I have found many things to do and see. Unfortunately, the forest is so spread out that I have yet to meet many of the others who live in this area. I do know that the Abbey is just across the way from mine house.

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: bright-eyed woman with a cheerful demeanor

npc_richter.voice_desc_zh: 男性，20-30歲，溫暖友善，沉穩有權威感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_richter.ref_zh_text: 「John-Paul 領主負責監督這座堡壘，不過 Horffe 爵士才是衛兵隊長。當然，我們其他人都在此服務 Lord British 以及 Britannia 的需求。」
npc_richter.ref_en_text: "Well, obviously there is many a vile beast looking to terrorize the countryside on the mainland. 'Tis our duty to protect the common man. In addition, we are here to provide examples of proper behavior to the general populace."

npc_russell.voice_desc_en: A mature male with a calm, authoritative tone, conveying contentment and wisdom; retain character context: Male, 40s, content shipwright, calm satisfied voice; visible traits: Shrewd-looking craftsman with contentment in his voice
npc_russell.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，沉穩有權威感，帶有智慧與閱歷，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_russell.ref_zh_text: 「他們來自海盜巢穴 (Buccaneer's Den)。大多數來這裡的人，都是因為在前往或離開海盜巢穴 (Buccaneer's Den)的途中迷路了。」
npc_russell.ref_en_text: "I build ships in New Magincia. It is a profession I enjoy very much. I also sell deeds for my ships, and sextants by which one can navigate the open seas."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: Shrewd-looking craftsman with contentment in his voice.
