npc_rutherford.voice_desc_en: A deep, authoritative voice with a tired but warm tone, conveying both authority and friendliness; retain character context: Male, 40s, tired one-armed man, weary but friendly voice; visible traits: tired, one-armed man with a weary expression
npc_rutherford.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，溫暖友善，沉穩有權威感，低沉有質感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_rutherford.ref_zh_text: 你看到一個神情疲憊、失去右臂的男人。他用單手抓了抓頭，朝你的方向瞇起眼睛。
npc_rutherford.ref_en_text: "Why, I got into a fight with this Hook once. I was lucky and I escaped losin' only my right arm and still with one good eye left. It was somewhere around that time that I started having second thoughts about my career as a pirate and now here I be.

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: tired, one-armed man with a weary expression

npc_salamon.voice_desc_en: A deep, raspy voice with a slow, deliberate pace and a touch of authority, conveying wisdom but also weariness; retain character context: Female, elderly, withered female ape-creature, creaky old voice; visible traits: wizened female ape-like creature withered appearance
npc_salamon.voice_desc_zh: 女性，年長，低沉有質感，語速沉穩，帶有智慧與閱歷，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_salamon.ref_zh_text: 她從你手中接過文件，看到 Ben 的簽名時笑了。「允許 Trellek 加入你們。祝你們好運，一路順風。」
npc_salamon.ref_en_text: "There is a woodcutter who lives in the western part of the forest. Silverleaf trees are being cut down by him. Emp houses are in Silverleaf trees. Contract must be signed by woodcutter to stop."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: wizened female ape-like creature withered appearance
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Female, elderly, withered female ape-creature, creaky old voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 女性，年長，沙啞蒼老，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_sam.voice_desc_en: A mature, bearded male with a content demeanor, delivering dialogue in a gentle, soothing tone that conveys warmth and authority; retain character context: Male, 40s, content florist, warm gentle voice, happy; visible traits: bearded man with deep-set laugh lines and gentle eyes
npc_sam.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，溫暖友善，低沉有質感，柔和，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_sam.ref_zh_text: 「在我看來，我並沒有真正的工作。我賣花給 New Magincia 的人們。雖然我有拿到錢，但這是我非常喜歡做的事。我想知道，這樣還能算是工作嗎？」他若有所思地抓了抓下巴。
npc_sam.ref_en_text: You see a content-looking bearded man, with deep-set laugh lines in his face and gentle eyes.

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: bearded man with deep-set laugh lines and gentle eyes
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, content florist, warm gentle voice, happy
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，溫暖溫柔，快樂，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_saralek.voice_desc_en: Female, middle-aged, A female voice in her late twenties, with a timid yet slightly authoritative tone, conveying nervousness while maintaining a steady pace; retain character context: Female, female ape-creature, nervous skittish voice; visible traits: nervous, ape-like features with green eyes and brown fur
npc_saralek.voice_desc_zh: 女性，中年，沉穩有權威感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_saralek.ref_zh_text: 「我有個關於 Trellek 能如何幫助你的主意。 Trellek 的口哨聲可以和鬼火聯繫。或許他可以為你做一個哨子。你接下來應該再去和他談談。」
npc_saralek.ref_en_text: "An idea how you can be helped by Trellek is had by me. Wisps are contacted by Trellek's whistling. A whistle for you can be made by him, perhaps. Talking with him again should be your next action."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: nervous, ape-like features with green eyes and brown fur
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Female, female ape-creature, nervous skittish voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 女性，緊張不安的，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_sarpling.voice_desc_en: Male, middle-aged, Deep, authoritative male voice with a hint of urgency and a touch of weariness; retain character context: Male, gargoyle, distracted fellowship member, hurried voice; visible traits: distracted, gargoyle-like appearance with horns and a red cloak
npc_sarpling.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，沉穩有權威感，低沉有質感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_sarpling.ref_zh_text: 告訴你， Runeb 想要陷害 Quan 破壞祭壇。如果計畫失敗就殺了 Quan，並控制 Terfin 的友誼會。這就是 Runeb 的目標。
npc_sarpling.ref_en_text: "To tell you Runeb wanted to frame Quan for the altars. To kill Quan if plan failed, and to be in control of The Fellowship in Terfin. To be Runeb's goal.

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: distracted, gargoyle-like appearance with horns and a red cloak
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, gargoyle, distracted fellowship member, hurried voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，心煩意亂的匆忙的，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_sean.voice_desc_en: Deep, authoritative voice with a touch of concern and focus, conveying seriousness without being overly dramatic; retain character context: Male, 30s-40s, concerned fellowship member, distracted voice; visible traits: serious, focused expression
npc_sean.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，沉穩有權威感，低沉有質感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_sean.ref_zh_text: 「就像我告訴你的，只有最優秀的工匠才能成為珠寶商，而我是最優秀的珠寶商。這難道還不夠明顯嗎？」 Sean 哼了一聲。「我的生意賺的錢比造幣廠還多！」他勉強地笑了笑。
npc_sean.ref_en_text: "I constantly require new materials with which to create my very special jewelry. I am always in the market to buy gems. If thou dost ever come across any, I am the man to come to if thou shouldst want to sell them and make money."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: serious, focused expression
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, 30s-40s, concerned fellowship member, distracted voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，憂心忡忡的心不在焉，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_sentri.voice_desc_en: Deep and resonant, mature male voice, confident yet approachable, with a touch of authority; retain character context: Male, 20s-30s, stylish fencer, confident and smooth voice; visible traits: dashing, slender man, stylishly dressed with flair
npc_sentri.voice_desc_zh: 男性，20-40歲，低沉有質感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_sentri.ref_zh_text: 「嗯，舉例來說，試著去其中一個小鎮看看，比方說 Paws 。那是個窮人的地方。而且還很臭。它就位在 Britain 鎮界之外。應該投入更多資金來改善整個地區的環境，而不僅僅是在首都建造新建築。我不知道 Lord British 在想什麼！」
npc_sentri.ref_en_text: "Well, for example, try going to one of the smaller towns, say, Paws. It is a poor man's place. It reeks, too. And 'tis only just beyond the Britain town limits. More money should be put into improving the land as a whole, not just in building new buildings in the capitol city. I do not know what Lord British is thinking!"

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: dashing, slender man, stylishly dressed with flair
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, 20s-30s, stylish fencer, confident and smooth voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，20-30歲，自信流暢，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_shamino.voice_desc_en: Deep and resonant, authoritative but not harsh; conveys experience and quiet strength; retain character context: Male, 40s, mysterious ranger, calm and measured voice with a hint of wisdom and melancholy; visible traits: weathered face with a mustache, calm demeanor
npc_shamino.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，沉穩有權威感，低沉有質感，語速沉穩，帶有智慧與閱歷，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_shamino.ref_zh_text: 「全 Britannia 的魔法似乎都受到了干擾。說，你還記得大森林裡的 Nicodemus 嗎？他瘋了，而且變得非常愚蠢。也許我們該去拜訪他。」
npc_shamino.ref_en_text: "Yes, I have been in Britain as of late, attempting to find work. Thou dost know that adventuring comes around too infrequently. One must find -other- diversions. Which reminds me... I have thy pocketwatch."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: weathered face with a mustache, calm demeanor
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, 40s, mysterious ranger, calm and measured voice with a hint of wisdom and melancholy
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，40多歲，平靜而有分寸，帶著一絲睿智和憂鬱，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_sherry.voice_desc_en: A mid-30s female voice, smooth yet authoritative, with a confident tone that conveys intelligence and authority; retain character context: Female, rat, squeaky intelligent voice, excited and friendly; visible traits: large mouse with an air of superior intelligence
npc_sherry.voice_desc_zh: 女性，中年，溫暖友善，沉穩有權威感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_sherry.ref_zh_text: 「白天我主要在皇家育嬰室協助 Nanna。晚上當 Nanna 去吃晚餐並參加她的友誼會集會時，我會單獨看顧孩子們。其他時間我則在城堡裡跑來跑去尋找老鼠食物！」
npc_sherry.ref_en_text: "It is much the same as it was when thou wert last here. There has been a bit of remodeling. After all, it has been 200 years since thou wert last here! I believe Lord British has a storeroom with quite a bit of equipment inside."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: large mouse with an air of superior intelligence
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Female, rat, squeaky intelligent voice, excited and friendly
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 女性，吱吱的智慧興奮而友好，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_shrine.voice_desc_en: Neutral, adult, Entity, shrine spirit, echoing reverent voice, divine quality
npc_shrine.voice_desc_zh: 中性，成年，自然清晰，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_shrine.ref_zh_text: 我們感謝你，聖者。你拯救了 Britannia 免於陷入可能的第二次黑暗時代。你再次證明了你作為 Lord British 意志體現者的價值。
npc_shrine.ref_en_text: Urgency breaks into the voice of the statue. "I lay upon thee a geas, and as thou art the Avatar, thou art bound to respond. Thy quest is to seek the Talisman of Infinity. Within this castle there lies a scroll which can tell thee of its use. Go now, for time grows short.

npc_silamo.voice_desc_en: Male, elderly, Deep, gravelly voice with a slow, deliberate pace and a touch of authority; retain character context: Male, gargoyle, frowning formal voice; visible traits: Frowning, formal, gargoyle-like
npc_silamo.voice_desc_zh: 男性，年長，低沉有質感，語速沉穩，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_silamo.ref_zh_text: 感覺因為沒有翅膀而受到不平等待遇。看到 Quaeven 加入友誼會後待遇變好了。我一直致力於單一性 (singularity) 的祭壇。但如果友誼會不在乎翅膀的話，或許我該改變了。」
npc_silamo.ref_en_text: "To feel I am treated less for an absence of wings. To see Quaeven treated better since joining The Fellowship. To be devoted to the altar of singularity. But, perhaps to change if The Fellowship cares not about wings."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: Frowning, formal, gargoyle-like
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, gargoyle, frowning formal voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，皺眉的正式，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_smith.voice_desc_en: A middle-aged man with horse-like features, speaking in a calm and authoritative tone, conveying warmth and authority; retain character context: Male, horse, simple direct voice, dry humor, equine snorts; visible traits: horse-like features with a calm demeanor
npc_smith.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，溫暖友善，沉穩有權威感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_smith.ref_zh_text: 「現在我們進入正題了。好吧，我給你一個線索，但我能得到什麼好處？讓我猜猜。金錢？愛情？不，以我對你的了解，大概什麼都沒有。如果我運氣好，你會走開別煩我。」
npc_smith.ref_en_text: "I thought as much. You've always been a selfish one. What do you want? Now, let's see... Money? Advice? Happiness? No, you usually want a clue of some sort, don't you. Of course, you may have become altruistic over the past 200 years....

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: horse-like features with a calm demeanor
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, horse, simple direct voice, dry humor, equine snorts
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男，簡單直接的冷幽默，噴鼻息，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_smithy.voice_desc_en: A mature, authoritative male voice with a smooth texture, steady pace, and warm tone, conveying confidence and experience; retain character context: Male, 30s-40s, well-dressed pirate, smooth voice; visible traits: well-dressed pirate with oil in his hair
npc_smithy.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，溫暖友善，沉穩有權威感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_smithy.ref_zh_text: 「只需將你想要下注的金幣數量放在一個或多個顏色上。使用轉盤，如果你猜對了，你的錢就會增加。」
npc_smithy.ref_en_text: "Thou canst bet on a triple, that is, three ones, three twos, or three threes. This has the highest payback. A '1, 2, 3' pays slightly less. A sum total of '4', '5', '7', or '8' pays the least. Do not place thy money in between numbers, especially the '4' and '5'. A '6' made up of anything other than three twos loses. After placing thy bet, spin the wheel."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: well-dressed pirate with oil in his hair
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, 30s-40s, well-dressed pirate, smooth voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，流暢，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_snaz.voice_desc_en: Warm and slightly wheedling, with a rough texture that hints at years of experience. Pace is steady but engaging; retain character context: Male, 30s-40s, crafty beggar, rough voice with a wheedling tone, false friendliness; visible traits: wheedling grin, rough voice
npc_snaz.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，溫暖友善，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_snaz.ref_zh_text: 你看見一個渾身髒兮兮的乞丐，他對你咧嘴一笑，彷彿你是他全世界最好的朋友。
npc_snaz.ref_en_text: "Have a heart, I pray thee! I have a wife and six hungry children to feed." He feels your stare upon him. "Oh, very well. Wouldst thou believe I have a cat and it just had kittens?"

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: wheedling grin, rough voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, 30s-40s, crafty beggar, rough voice with a wheedling tone, false friendliness
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，粗聲粗氣，語氣哄騙，虛假友善，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_spark.voice_desc_en: A young male voice, earnest and slightly cracked, conveying both vulnerability and resolve; retain character context: Male, teenage boy, earnest and emotional, voice cracking with adolescence, slightly insecure; visible traits: Dirty, unkempt, appears emotional but composed
npc_spark.voice_desc_zh: 男性，年輕，自然清晰，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_spark.ref_zh_text: 你得找個鐵匠來做那件事。我敢打賭我爸能做到……我的意思是，如果他還活著，他就能做到……
npc_spark.ref_en_text: "I am not sure if it's the same one, but I think I saw Father with a scroll just like that one or two days ago. I know he was making something special for someone. I am fairly certain it was at his shop."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: Dirty, unkempt, appears emotional but composed.
_portrait_voice_analysis.temperament: Earnest, slightly insecure, with a hint of determination.
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, teenage boy, earnest and emotional, voice cracking with adolescence, slightly insecure
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，十幾歲的男孩，認真而情緒化，青春期時聲音嘶啞，有點不安全感，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_sprellic.voice_desc_en: Young male, timid and fearful, high-pitched but steady voice, slow and hesitant pace, soft yet slightly anxious tone; retain character context: Male, young adult, timid and fearful, high-pitched nervous voice, stammers slightly; visible traits: scrawny, timid-looking man with wide eyes and a nervous demeanor
npc_sprellic.voice_desc_zh: 男性，年輕，柔和，語速沉穩，帶有憂慮感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_sprellic.ref_zh_text: 「Vokes 離開後，我遇到了一個名叫 Timmons 的男人。他要求我將榮譽旗幟歸還給傷痕圖書館。我告訴他我辦不到，他也向我挑戰一場生死決鬥。我告訴他我很忙，但他把挑戰安排在我和 Vokes 的決鬥之後馬上進行。
npc_sprellic.ref_en_text: "Later that day I ran into a man named Vokes. He is a fighter at the Library of Scars. He asked me to return the honor flag and when I tried to tell him I could not, he hit me. Then he challenged me to a duel to the death to be fought right after my duel with Syria.

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: scrawny, timid-looking man with wide eyes and a nervous demeanor
_portrait_voice_analysis.temperament: timid and fearful, high-pitched voice, stammers slightly
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, young adult, timid and fearful, high-pitched nervous voice, stammers slightly
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，青年，膽怯害怕，緊張，輕微結巴，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_stone_guardian.voice_desc_en: Male, adult, Male, elemental, deep rumbling stone voice, slow and wise
npc_stone_guardian.voice_desc_zh: 男性，成年，低沉有質感，語速沉穩，帶有智慧與閱歷，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_stone_guardian.ref_zh_text: 是的，休息吧，我的朋友。休息並療傷，這樣你才能變得堅強，並有能力面對你眼前的危險。祝你有個好夢！
npc_stone_guardian.ref_en_text: "So, Avatar! The moment of truth has come! You can destroy the Black Gate, but you will never return to your beloved Earth. Or you can come through now and go home! It is your choice!"

npc_stuart.voice_desc_en: Deep, authoritative tone with a slight rasp, steady pace, and warm authority; retain character context: Male, 20s-30s, arrogant actor, pompous theatrical voice; visible traits: assertive, confident
npc_stuart.voice_desc_zh: 男性，20-30歲，溫暖友善，活潑有戲劇感，沉穩有權威感，低沉有質感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_stuart.ref_zh_text: Stuart 對你耳語：「Jesse 完全不對！哎呀，-你- 都比他更適合演聖者！而 -你- 可能連演個裝藥材的袋子都不行！這不是在說你，而是在說 Jesse 。」
npc_stuart.ref_en_text: Stuart whispers to you, "Jesse is all wrong! Why, -thou- wouldst make a better Avatar than he! And -thou- probably couldst not act thy way out of a reagent bag! That is not a reflection on thee, but on Jesse."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: assertive, confident
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, 20s-30s, arrogant actor, pompous theatrical voice
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 男性，20-30歲，活潑有戲劇感，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_sullivan.voice_desc_en: Deep, resonant voice of a seasoned man, conveying warmth and authority while maintaining a gentle pace; retain character context: Male, 20s-30s, cheerful ex-convict, bright and grateful voice; visible traits: weathered face with a broad smile
npc_sullivan.voice_desc_zh: 男性，20-40歲，溫暖友善，低沉有質感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_sullivan.ref_zh_text: 他盡可能地向你傾斜。這也許是他一生中第一次變得如此嚴肅。「實際上，應得是一個相對的詞。我終於意識到——白天在刑架上待了好幾個小時，讓我有很多時間去體會——友誼會的真實本質。 Batlin 、 Abraham 和 Danag ，他們都錯了。
npc_sullivan.ref_en_text: 'Twas very kind of thee to release me from my cell. I shall now return to my former life. Good day!

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: weathered face with a broad smile
_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_en: Male, 20s-30s, cheerful ex-convict, bright and grateful voice

npc_tavenor.voice_desc_en: A middle-aged, masculine voice with a deep, resonant tone, cautious yet authoritative, conveying a sense of experience and wisdom; retain character context: Male, ape-creature, cautious careful voice; visible traits: ape-like features with cautious demeanor

npc_tavenor.ref_en_text: "`Job' now understood by me. No job is had by me. Food is gathered by me and my family." He watches you carefully. "Your job is to cut down Silverleaf trees, yes?"

npc_taylor.voice_desc_zh: 男性，20-40歲，溫暖友善，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_taylor.ref_zh_text: 「你若非知不可，民間傳說倒是一直堅稱牠們棲息在森林一帶，就在森靈族的聚落附近。據說，森靈族能夠與牠們交談。」他聳了聳肩：「你若真想找，大可自己去碰碰運氣，但換作是我，我可不會把寶貴的時間浪費在這種事情上。」
npc_taylor.ref_en_text: "Julius? I cannot be certain, but 'tis possible he may be someone who now resides in the... cemetery. I have heard that name mentioned as someone who was brought to the Abbey to be buried, though I know not who brought him and I do not remember from whom I heard it. I do hope he was not a friend of thine," he says, apologetically.

Pace is steady and measured; retain character context: Male, gargoyle, dignified and formal, slightly gravelly but hospitable tone; visible traits: winged gargoyle in his physical prime with a dignified demeanor
npc_teregus.voice_desc_zh: 男性，成年，溫暖友善，低沉有質感，語速沉穩，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_teregus.ref_zh_text: 「聽說鎮上有某人計畫破壞祭壇的物理實體。當然，這與實際摧毀控制、熱情和勤勉的基本原則不同，但對我們來說依然是件壞事。如果有時間的話，或許能幫我們查出是誰在策劃這件事。當你決定行動方針時，帶著證據回來找我。會非常感謝你的協助。」
npc_teregus.ref_en_text: "To have been a sad case. To have wished to have been able to save him. To always have been uncontrollable, but to have gotten worse in the last few years. To have seemed to want to start as many fights as possible. To have found a reason for using his strength against all those weaker when to have joined The Fellowship."

npc_time_lord.voice_desc_en: Deep, resonant, ancient male voice with a timeless echo, conveying wisdom and authority; retain character context: Male, ancient being, timeless and mysterious voice, deep resonant tone with otherworldly echo; visible traits: timeless and mysterious
npc_time_lord.voice_desc_zh: 男性，年長，低沉有質感，帶有智慧與閱歷，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_time_lord.ref_zh_text: 恭喜你，聖者，摧毀了球體。我從我的天球監獄中解脫了。我感謝你。但我很遺憾地通知你，守護者設計了那個球體，它的毀滅永久地癱瘓了月之門，以及你的月之寶珠。你無法再透過紅色的月之門回到你的家鄉了。
npc_time_lord.ref_en_text: "The land is under attack by a powerful and malicious being from another dimension, and thou art the only one who can stop him! I have been trapped here by a trick, due to a sorcery which The Guardian has performed. The Guardian has put a wrinkle in the space-time continuum by creating a powerful 'generator' which has made the Moongates and thine Orb of the Moons mostly inoperable.

npc_tobias.voice_desc_en: A young man with a sullen demeanor and resentful mutterings, conveying a sense of youthful frustration; retain character context: Male, teen-20s, sullen young man, resentful muttering voice; visible traits: Sullen, avoiding eye contact
npc_tobias.voice_desc_zh: 男性，年輕，自然清晰，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_tobias.ref_zh_text: 「那些該死的友誼會的人知道每個人距離身無分文永遠只有一餐之遙。他們說要我們立刻加入，因為庇護所是為了幫助友誼會成員而設的。如果我們有一天需要住在那裡，他們可能會為了其他友誼會成員而把我們拒之門外。」
npc_tobias.ref_en_text: "That is right! Garritt did it. I just know it. He was in my room the other day when I came in from the fields. He said he was looking for a ball, but I do not believe him. Thou canst believe me or not, I do not care. But if thou art truly the Avatar, thou wilt know I am telling the truth."

npc_tory.ref_zh_text: 「衛兵隊長 Horffe 爵士，是一隻石像鬼。他被兩名人類發現並撫養成為一名勇敢的騎士。他是一位非常忠誠的戰士，很少離開 John-Paul 領主的身邊。」
npc_tory.ref_en_text: "The Captain of the guard, Sir Horffe, is a gargoyle. He was found by two humans who raised him to be a valiant knight. He is a very dedicated warrior, and rarely leaves Lord John-Paul's side."

npc_trellek.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，低沉有質感，語速沉穩，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_trellek.ref_zh_text: 他開始迅速地在周圍尋找一根枯死、中空的掉落樹枝。不久他找到了一根令他滿意的。他顯然有些尷尬，轉過身背對著你，做出的動作類似於從酒壺上拔出軟木塞。
npc_trellek.ref_en_text: He begins quickly searching around for a dead, hollow, fallen tree branch. Shortly he finds one that meets his satisfaction. Apparently embarrassed, he turns his back to you, and makes motions similar to one twisting a cork from a flagon.

npc_trent.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，低沉有質感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_trent.ref_zh_text: Trent 瞪著你，他的眼神中透露出一種強烈的情感，讓你對他的態度毫不懷疑。「如果我認為你會在接到通知的那一刻就跑掉，我就不會請求你幫我救出我的摯愛了。
npc_trent.ref_en_text: He holds up one hand as you say the name of his late wife. "Please, do not say that name. It takes from me a little of mine Hatred, which is all I have now. Wouldst thou rob me of the one thing that keeps me alive?" It would seem that he is unaware of the fact that he is, indeed, no longer alive. An odd expression crosses his face.

npc_tseramed.voice_desc_zh: 男性，30-40歲，溫暖友善，沉穩有權威感，低沉有質感，帶有智慧與閱歷，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_tseramed.ref_zh_text: 「請告訴我一件事，如果您方便的話。自從我首次學習荒野求生技能以來，已經過去許多年了。這種技能也包括了動用武力的技巧，而我必須知道……聖者究竟是偏好以神祕的魔法附魔來克敵制勝，還是更傾向於肢體力量與戰鬥武勇呢？」
npc_tseramed.ref_en_text: We need not be concerned about these bees, so long as we have a number of my trusty arrows.

npc_unknown.ref_zh_text: 這個生物沒有回應。它只是沉默地站在原地，無視你的話語，彷彿你的存在完全不值得注意。
npc_unknown.ref_en_text: The creature does not respond. It remains silent and still, ignoring your words as though your presence is not worth noticing.

npc_wench.voice_desc_en: Young woman with a confident and professional tone, conveying authority while maintaining a warm and approachable demeanor; retain character context: Female, 20s, attractive bath attendant, sultry voice, professional warmth; visible traits: seductive eyes, attractive appearance

npc_wench.ref_en_text: Wench helps you with your clothing and leads you to a comfortable table. You lie on your stomach and the woman expertly kneads and rubs your aching muscles, slowly sending you into a state of total relaxation. After a while, Wench helps you up and you dress.

npc_weston.voice_desc_en: A deep, resonant voice with a touch of weariness and authority, conveying both the prisoner's despair and his attempt to maintain composure; retain character context: Male, 20s, hopeless young prisoner, defeated sad voice; visible traits: disheartened young man behind bars
npc_weston.voice_desc_zh: 男性，20-30歲，低沉有質感，帶有憂慮感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_weston.ref_zh_text: 「好了！你的廢話夠多了！整天唧唧歪歪地抱怨那可怕糟糕的階級制度！怎麼，接下來你是不是要說社會該為你的罪行負責？沒有任何人對維持法律和秩序表達任何感謝。沒錯，當然沒有！反而全世界的憐憫都給了那些對社會造成真正威脅的危險違法者！」
npc_weston.ref_en_text: "Oh, now! Do not go and bring up poverty as an excuse as to why thou hast turned to crime! My father was so poor he and his family had to eat dirt. But he still raised me proper. Beat the stuffings out of me if he ever so much as imagined I did anything wrong, I can tell thee that!"

npc_willy.voice_desc_en: Warm, enthusiastic male voice with a slightly nasally tone, steady pace, and friendly warmth; retain character context: Male, 20s, enthusiastic young man, eager and friendly voice, slightly nerdy; visible traits: clean-looking, portly young man
npc_willy.voice_desc_zh: 男性，20-30歲，溫暖友善，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_willy.ref_zh_text: Willy 擦去一滴眼淚。「都走了。兩個人都走了。去天上那個偉大的廚房與我的祖先相聚了。我永遠無法像他們那樣烹飪。但我還是堅持著，努力保持家族的名聲，這就是我成為烘焙師的原因。但我想這不是唯一的原因。」
npc_willy.ref_en_text: Willy wipes away a tear. "Gone. Both of them. Gone to join mine ancestors in that great kitchen in the sky. I will never be able to cook as they did. Still I plod along, trying to keep the family name alive, and that is why I am a baker. But I suppose it is not the only reason."

npc_wis_sur.voice_desc_en: A mid-thirties, masculine voice with a formal tone, authoritative yet gentle, conveying wisdom and command; retain character context: Male, gargoyle, authoritative winged gargoyle, formal commanding voice; visible traits: winged gargoyle with an authoritative disposition
npc_wis_sur.voice_desc_zh: 男性，中年，溫暖友善，沉穩有權威感，帶有智慧與閱歷，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_wis_sur.ref_zh_text: 「只熟悉 Vesper 裡的其他石像鬼。告訴你去問 Ansikart ，他認識這裡所有的石像鬼。告訴你關於以下其中一項？」
npc_wis_sur.ref_en_text: "To be familiar with only the other gargoyles in Vesper. To tell you to ask Ansikart, who knows all other gargoyles here. To tell you about one of the following?"

npc_wislem.voice_desc_zh: 男性，成年，低沉有質感，語速沉穩，帶有智慧與閱歷，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_wislem.ref_zh_text: Wislem 聽了你關於 Trinsic 謀殺案的故事。「聽到這個很難過。建議你去 Terfin 拜訪 Draxinusom 國王，並告訴他關於 Inamo 的事。他會知道誰是 Inamo 的父母。建議你盡快傳達這個消息。
npc_wislem.ref_en_text: Wislem listens to your story about the murders in Trinsic. "To be sad to hear this. To suggest that you visit Lord Draxinusom in Terfin and tell him about Inamo. He will know who Inamo's parent gargoyle is. To recommend you relay this news as soon as possible.

npc_xorinia.voice_desc_en: Neutral, middle-aged, A soft, ethereal voice with a gentle cadence and a touch of mystery; retain character context: Entity, will-o-wisp, alien echoing voice, strange cadence, collective we-speech; visible traits: ethereal, light-colored hair, glowing orb
npc_xorinia.voice_desc_zh: 中性，中年，溫暖友善，柔和，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_xorinia.ref_zh_text: 「『Xorinia』是穿梭於不同位面，與維度之間的資訊通道。同時，『Xorinia』亦負責將所有對其群體成長，不可或缺的資訊，進行編目存檔。『汝』手中正掌握著對『吾』而言，可能具備價值的資訊。與此同時，『吾』亦掌握著『汝』所渴求的情報。」
npc_xorinia.ref_en_text: "The Undrian Council has information that there is a human entity in 'your' dimension that has been called 'the wisest man in Britannia.' This entity is known as 'Alagner' and lives in 'your' colony of 'New Magincia'. 'Alagner' has what the entity calls a 'notebook'. The 'notebook' is a collection of information."

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: ethereal, light-colored hair, glowing orb

npc_yvella.voice_desc_en: Warm, mature female voice with a slight authority and gentle cadence; retain character context: Female, 20s, polite young housewife, soft courteous voice; visible traits: matronly appearance with concern on face
npc_yvella.voice_desc_zh: 女性，20-40歲，溫暖友善，柔和，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_yvella.ref_zh_text: 「他是我們的鎮長。 Eldroth 建議我們選他，所以我們當然選了。然而，我們私下說，如果 Auston 不趕快做點什麼，我認為我們應該換個新人。事實上，你應該競選鎮長，大人。你覺得如何？你想競選鎮長嗎？」
npc_yvella.ref_en_text: "He is our mayor. Eldroth recommended that we elect him, so, of course, we did. However, between the two of us, I think we ought to have someone new if Auston does not do something quickly. As a matter of fact, thou shouldst run for mayor, milord. What dost thou think? Wouldst thou like to run for mayor?"

_portrait_voice_analysis.visual_traits: matronly appearance with concern on face

_portrait_voice_analysis.previous_voice_desc_zh: 女，20多歲，溫柔有禮的，用標準的普通話朗讀

npc_zelda.voice_desc_en: A female voice in her late twenties or early thirties, with a crisp and authoritative tone, conveying an icy yet commanding presence; retain character context: Female, 30s-40s, cold woman, icy clipped voice; visible traits: icy stare, cold demeanor
npc_zelda.voice_desc_zh: 女性，30-40歲，沉穩有權威感，用標準的普通話朗讀
npc_zelda.ref_zh_text: 「我沒什麼時間處理這個，」她嘆了口氣。「我只跟露加翁的負責人 (Lycaeum head) 和他的雙胞胎兄弟 Brion 比較熟。訓練師 (trainer) 也在這間露加翁裡學習。」她抬頭看著天花板，彷彿在讀一份隱形懸在半空中的清單。
